a: En ishsha poda maaser sheni belo chomesh. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: ishsha poda maaser sheni belo chomesh. hechi dame? illema bezuze devaal, umaaser devaal – shelichuteh devaal ka avda?!
Veella bezuze dida umaaser dideh – "ish" amar rachamana, velo ishsha!
Ella lav ki hay gavvna, deakni la acher mane, vaamar la: "al menat shettifdi bo et hammaaser", veippecha shemana lehu!
Amar abbaye: efoch. rava amar: leolam la tefoch, vehacha bemaaser daata mibbe nasha askinan, verabbi meir letameh, deamar: maaser mamon hekdesh hu, vela kane leh baal.
Verabbanan letamayyhu, deamri: mamon hedyot hu, vekane leh baal, hilkach shelichuta devaal kaavda.

Tana: yotze beshen vaayin verashe evarim sheenan chozrim. bishlama shen vaayin – ketivi. ella rashe evarim menalan? dumeya deshen vaayin, ma shen vaayin mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin – af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin.
Veema nihvo shen vaayin kishne chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin! tzericha, dei ketav rachamana "shen", hava amena afillu
b: Shen dechalav, ketav rachamana "ayin". vei ketav rachamana "ayin" hava amena ma ayin shennivra immo – af kol shennivra immo, aval shen – la, tzericha.
Veema: "ki yakke" – kalal, "shen vaayin" – parat. kelal uferat, en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat. shen vaayin – in, midde acharina – la!
"Lachofshi yeshallechennu" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash mum shebbaggaluy veenan chozrim – af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin.

I ma happerat meforash – mumin shebbaggaluy uvatel mimmelachto veeno chozer – af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veeno chozer uvatel mimmelachto. allema tanya: talash bizkano vedildel bo etzem – eved yotze bahem lecherut! "lachofshi yeshallechennu" – ribbuya hu.
Vei ribbuya hu, afillu hikkahu al yado vetzamta vesofah lachzor name, allema tanya: hikkahu al yado vetzamta vesofah lachzor – en eved yotze bah lecherut? im ken, shen vaayin may ahani leh?

Tanu rabbanan: bechullam, eved yotze bahem lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer: eno tzarich. rabbi eliezer omer: tzarich. rabbi tarfon omer: eno tzarich. rabbi akiva omer: tzarich.

Hammachriim lifne chachamim omrim: nirin divre rabbi tarfon beshen vaayin, shehattora zikketa lo, vedivre rabbi akiva bishar evarim, hoil ukenas chachamim hu. kenas hu?! kerae ka darshinan! ella: hoil umidrash chachamim hu.

May tama derabbi shimon? yalef "shilluach" "shilluach" meishsha. ma ishsha bishtar – af eved name bishtar. verabbi meir: i ketav "chofshi" levassof – kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtav "lachofshi yeshallechennu" – hava leh chofshi meikkara.

Tanu rabbanan: hikkahu al eno vesimmeah, al ozno vechershah – eved yotze bahen lecherut. neged eno veeno roe, keneged ozno veeno shomea – en eved yotze bahen lecherut. amar rav shemen lerav ashe: lememra dekala lav kelum hu?

Vehatane rame bar yechezkel: tarnegol shehoshit rosho laavir keli zechuchit, vetaka bo ushevaro meshallem nezek shalem. veamar rav yosef, amri be rav: sus shetztzanaf vachamor shennaar, veshavru kelim betoch habbayit – meshallemim chatzi nezek.

Amar leh: shane adam, dechevan devar daat hu – ihu meyvaet nafsheh. kidtanya: hammavit et chavero – patur middine adam vechayyayv bedine shamayim. ketzad? taka beozno vechersho – patur, achazahu vetaka beozno vechersho – chayyayv.

Tanu rabbanan: hikkahu al eno vechahata, al shinno venadda, im yachol lehishtammesh bahen achshav – en eved yotze bahen lecherut, veim lav – eved yotze bahen lecherut. tanya iddach: hare shehayta eno kehuya vesimmeah, shinno neduda vehippilah, im yachol lehishtammesh bahen kevar – eved yotze bahen lecherut, veim lav – en eved yotze bahen lecherut.
Utzericha, dei ashmoinan hach kammayyta, mishshum demeikkara nehora beriyya vehasheta nehora kechisha. aval hacha, demeikkara name nehora kechisha – ema la.
Vei ashmoinan ha, mishshum desammeya ligmare, aval hatam, dela sammeya ligmare ema la, tzericha.

Tanu rabbanan: hare shehaya rabbo rofe, veamar lo lichchol lo eno vesimmeah, lachtor lo shinno vehippilah – sichek baadon, veyatza lecherut. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: "veshichatah" – ad sheyyitkavven leshachatah.

Verabbanan, hay "veshichatah", may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya, rabbi elazar omer: hare shehoshit yado lime shifchato vesimme ubbar shebbemeeha – patur. may tama? deamar kera: "veshichatah" – ad sheyyechavven leshachatah.
Veiddach? mivshichet" "shichatah" nafka. veiddach? "shichet" "shichatah" la daresh.
Amar rav sheshet: hare shehayta eno semuya, vachatatah – eved yotze bahen lecherut. may tama? mechussar ever hu.
Vetanna tuna: tammut vezachrut bivhema, veen tammut vezachrut beofot.
Yachol yavsha gappah, niktea raglah, nechteta enah? talmud lomar: "min haof" – velo kol haof.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hayta lo

a: Yeteret, vachatachah – eved yotze bahen lecherut. amar rav huna: vehu shennisperet al gav hayyad.

Save denazonya la ato lefirkeh derav chisda, amar leh lerav hamenuna: zil tzanneinhu. azal amar lehu: may tama la ato rabbanan lefirka? amaru leh: ammay nete? divenan minneh milleta vela peshat lan. amar lehu: mi beetu minnay midde vela pashetna lechu?
Beo minneh: eved shesserso rabbo babbetzim, mahu? kemum shebbaggaluy dame, o la? la hava bideh. amru lo: ma shemach? amar lehu: hamenuna. amaru leh: lav hamenuna, ella karnuna.
Ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: matnita beo minnach. ditnan: esrim vearbaa rashe evarim shebbaadam kullam en metammein mishshum michya,

Veellu hem: rashe etzbaot yadayim veraglayim, verashe oznayim, verosh hachotem, verosh haggeviyyay verashe daddim shebbaishsha. rabbi yehuda omer: af shebbaish. vetane ala: bechullam eved yotze bahem lecherut. rabbi omer: af hasserus. ben azzay omer: af hallashon.
Amar mar: rabbi omer af hasserus. serus demay? illema serus degid, hayeynu geviyyay. ella lav: serus devetzim?
Rabbi omer af hasserus. verabbi, lashon la? ureminhu: hare mi shehaya mazze venitteza hazzaa al piv, rabbi omer: hizza. vachachamim omrim: lo hizza.
May lav al leshono? lo, al sefatav. al sefatav peshita! mahu detema zimna dechalem sifvateh, ka mashma lan.
Vehatanya: al leshono! veod tanya: veshennittal rov hallashon, rabbi omer: rov hamedabber shebbilshono!
Ella, rabbi omer: serus, vela mibbaya lashon. ben azzay amar: lashon, aval serus – la. umay "af"? akkammayyta. i hachi, nakdema deven azzay beresha!
Tanna shama lidrabbi vekava, veshama lidven azzay vetanya[], umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.
Amar ulla: hakkol modim belashon leinyan tumea degaluy hu etzel hashsheretz. may tama? "asher yigga bo" amar rachamana, vehay name bar negia hu.
Leinyan tevila – ketamun dame. may tama: "verachatz besaro bemayim" amar rachamana, ma besaro meabbaray – af kol meabbaray.
Lo nechleku ella leinyan hazzaa. rabbi medamme la letumea, verabbanan medammu la litvila.
Vetarvayyhu behay kera kamippalgi: "vehizza hattahor al hattame vegomer" rabbi savar: "vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii vechitteo",
Rabbanan savri: "vechitteo bayyom hashshevii vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim".
Verabbanan name, nedammeyay letumea? tohora mittohorah hava leh lemelaf. verabbi, nedammeyay litvila? "vechibbes begadav" – hifsik hainyan.

Vesavar rabbi leinyan tevila ketamun dame? vehaamar ravin amar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beshifcha shel bet rabbi shettavla, vealta venimtza etzem ben shinneha, vehitzrichah rabbi tevila acheret.
Nehi deviat mayim la baenan, mekom harauy lavo bo mayim baenan,
Kidrabbi zera. deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla – en billa meakkevet bo. vesheeno rauy levilla – billa meakkevet bo.
b: Ketannae: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut" – kullan babbetzim, divre rabbi yehuda.

Babbetzim velo baggid? ella: kullan af babbetzim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kullam baggid. rabbi yose omer: "mauch vechatut" – af babbetzim, "natuk vecharut" – begid – in, bevetzim – la.
Mishna behema gassa niknet bimsira, vehaddakka behagebaha, divre rabbi meir verabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: behema dakka niknet bimshicha.

Gemara daresh rav bekimchonya: behema gassa niknet bimshicha. ashkechinhu shemuel letalmide derav, amar lehu: mi amar rav behema gassa niknet bimshicha? vehaanan bimsira tenan! verav name bimsira amar, hadar beh mehahi? hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: vachachamim omrim: zo vezo niknet bimshicha. rabbi shimon omer: zo vezo behagebaha.
Matkef la rav yosef: ella meatta, pil lerabbi shimon bamme yikkane? amar leh abbaye: bachalifin. i name besocher et mekomo.
Rabbi zera amar: mevi arbaa kelim umannichan tachat raglav. shamat minna: kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher – kana lokeach? hacha bemay askinan, besimta.

a: I name: bachavile zemorot.

Mishna nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut – niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. sheen lahem achrayut – en niknin ella bimshicha. nechasim sheen lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka,
Vezokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut lishshava alehen.

Gemara bechesef menalan? amar chizkiyya: amar kera: "sadot bakkesef yiknu". veema ad deikka shetar, dichtiv: "vechatov bassefer vechatom"! i ketiv "yiknu" levassof – kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "yiknu" meikkara, kesef – kane, shetar – reaya bealma hu.
Amar rav: lo shanu ella bimkom sheen kotvin et hashshetar, aval bimkom shekkotvin et hashshetar – lo kana. vei paresh – paresh.

Ki ha derav idi bar avin ki zaven ara, amar: i baena bechaspa – ikne, i baena bishtara – ikne. i baena bechaspa – ikne, dei baetu lemihdar, la matzitu hadritu. vei baena bishtara – ikne, dei baena lemihdar, hadarna bi.

Uvishtar. menalan? illema mishshum dichtiv: "vechatov bassefer vechatom vehaed edim", vehaamrat shetar reaya bealma hu! ella mehacha, "vaekkach et sefer hammikna". amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bishtar mattana, aval bemecher lo kana ad sheyyitten lo damim.

Metiv rav hamenuna: bishtar ketzad? katav lo al hanneyayr o al hacheres, af al pi sheen bahem shave peruta, "sadi mechura lach", "sadi netuna lecha" – hare zo mechura unetuna. hu motev la vehu mefarek la: bemocher sadehu mippene raatah.
Rav ashe amar: bemattana bikkesh littenah lo, velamma katav lo leshon mecher – kede leyappot et kocho.
Uvachazaka. menalan? amar chizkiyya: amar kera: "ushevu bearechem asher tefastem", bamme tefastem – bishiva. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "virishtem otah vishavtem bah", bamme yerashtem – bishiva.
Vesheen lahem achrayut en niknin ella bimshicha. menalan? dichtiv: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha" – davar hannikne miyyad leyad.
Ulerabbi yochanan deamar: devar tora maot konot, may ikka lememar? tanna takkanta derabbanan katane.
Nechasim sheen lahem achrayut. menahane mille? amar chizkiyya: deamar kera: "vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot vegomer im are metzurot bihuda".
Ibbaya lehu: baenan tzevurim, o la? amar rav yosef: ta shema: rabbi akiva omer: karka kol shehu chayyevet bappea, uvabbikkurim,
b: Velichtov aleha perosbul, veliknot immah nechasim sheen lahem achrayut. vei amrat baenan tzevurim, kol shehu lemay chaze?

Targevma rav shemuel bar bisna kammeh derav yosef: kegon shennaatz bah machat. amar leh rav yosef: kevastan! ikkefal tanna leashmoinan machat? amar rav ashe: man lema lan dela tela bah marganita deshavvya alpa zuze.

Ta shema, amar rabbi elazar: maase bemadoni echad shehaya birushalayim shehayu lo mittaltelin harebe, uvikkesh littenam bemattana. amru lo: en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka. ma asa? halach velakach bet sela samuch lirushalayim, veamar: "tzefoni ze lifloni, veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot", vamet, vekiyyeymu et devarav.
Vei amrat baenan tzevurim bah, bet sela lemay chaze? mi savrat bet sela, sela mammash? may sela – dinfish tuva. veammay karu leh sela – dikshe kesela.
Ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad shechala birushalayim – kerabbi eliezer, veamri la: bari haya – kerabbanan,

Shehayu lo mittaltelin harebe uvikkesh littenam bemattana, amru lo: en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka. ma asa? halach velakach bet rova samuch lirushalayim, veamar: "tefach al tefach lifloni veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot", vamet, vekiyyeymu chachamim et devarav. vei amrat baenan tzevurim, tefach al tefach lemay chaze?
Hacha bemay askinan, lidme. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach mea tzon umea chaviyyot mammash, naykninhu nihaleh bachalifin.
Veella may, lidme? naykninhu nihaleh bimshicha! ella: deleteh limkabbel mattana. hachi name, deleteh limkabbel mattana.
Venizkinhu nihaleh aggav acher? la samcha dateh, savar shamet veachel lehu.
Veella may "en lo takkana"? hachi kaamar: lemay dela samcha dateh – en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka.
Ta shema: maase berabban gamliel uzekenim shehayu baim bisfina, amar lahem rabban gamliel lazzekenim: issur sheani atid lamod

a: Natun lo lihoshua, umekomo musekar lo. veissur acher sheani atid lamod natun lo laakiva ben yosef, kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim, umekomo musekar lo. shema minna baenan tzevurim ba! shane hatam, ki hechi dela laytrechinhu.

Ta shema, deamar rava bar yitzchak amar rav: shene shetarot hen: "zechu besade zo lifloni vechitvu lo et hashshetar" – chozer bashshetar, veeno chozer bassade. "al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar" – chozer ben bashshetar ben bassade.

Verav chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna: shelosha shetarot hen. tere – ha daamaran, iddach: im kadam mocher vechatav lo et hashshetar, keotah sheshshaninu: kotvim shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo. kevan shehechzik immo bakkarka – nikna shetar bechol makom shehu.
Shema minna la baenan tzevurim ba! shane shetar deafsera deara hu.
Veha ala katane: zo hi sheshshaninu: nechasim sheen lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut bechesef bishtar uvachazaka! shema minna: la baenan tzevurim bah, shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: mi baenan "aggav" o la? ta shema, dekatane kol hane, vela katane aggav. uletamaych, "keni" mi katane?
Ella, ad deamar "keni"? hacha name, ad daamar "aggav". vehilcheta: tzevurim – la baenan, "aggav" ukeni" – baenan.
Ibbaya lehu: sade bemecher umetaltelin bemattana mahu? ta shema: issur sheani atid lamod, natun lihoshua umekomo musekar lo, shema minna!
Ibbaya lehu: sade leechad, umetaltelin leacher mahu? ta shema: issur sheani atid lamod natun laakiva ben yosef kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim umekomo musekar lo.
May "musekar" – musekar lemaaser. vei baet ema: shane rabbi akiva, deyad aniyyim hava.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella shennatan deme chullan, aval lo natan deme chullan – lo kana ella keneged meotav.

Tanya kevoteh derava: yafe koach hakkesef mikkoach hashshetar, vechoach hashshetar mikkoach hakkesef. yafe koach hakkesef – shehakkesef podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni, ma sheen ken bishtar. veyafe koach hashshetar – shehashshetar motzi bevat yisrael, ma sheen ken bechesef.

Veyafe koach shenehem mikkoach chazaka, vechoach chazaka mikkoach shenehem. yafe koach shenehem – sheshshenehem konim beeved ivri, ma sheen ken bachazaka. yafe koach chazaka – shechazaka machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot, kevan shehechzik beachat mehem – kenaam kullam.
b: Bamme devarim amurim – shennatan lo deme chullan, aval lo natan lo deme chullan – lo kana ella keneged meotav. mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot, kevan shehechzik beachat mehen – kana et kullan.
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: teda, sheillu masar lo eser behemot beafsar echad vaamar leh "kene" – mi la kane? amar leh: mi dame? hatam iggudo beyado, hacha en iggudo beyado.
Ikka deamri: amar rav acha bereh derav ika: teda dela kane, illu masar lo eser behemot beafsar echad veamar lo "zo kene" – mi kane?
Mi dame? hatam gufim muchelakim, hacha saddana deara chad hu.
Vezokkim et hannechasim vechulei. amar ulla: minnayin legilgul shevua min hattora?

Shenneemar: "veamra haishsha amen amen", utenan: al ma hi omeret "amen amen"? "amen" al haala, "amen" al "hashshevua". "amen" im meish ze, "amen" im meish acher. "amen" shello satiti arusa unesua veshomeret yavam uchenusa.
Hay arusa hechi dame? illema dekanni la keshehi arusa, veka mashke la keshehi arusa, vehatnan arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, may tama – "tachat ishech" amar rachamana, velekka.
Ella dekanni la keshehi arusa, venistera keshehi arusa, veka mashke la keshehi nesua,
Mi badki la mayya? "venikka haish meavon" amar rachamana, bizman shehaish menukke meavon – mayim bodkim et ishto, en ish menukke meavon – en hammayim bodkim et ishto.
Ella al yede gilgul!
Ashkechan sota, deissura, mamona menalan? tana deve rabbi yishmael: kal vachomer: uma sota

a: Shello nittena lehittava beed echad – megalgelin, mamon, shennittan lehittava beed echad – eno din shemgalgelin?
Ashkechan bevadday, safek menalan?
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: neemra shevua bachutz, veneemra shevua bifnim. ma shevua haamura bifnim – asa bah safek kevadday, af shevua haamura bachutz – asa bah safek kevadday.
Ad hechan gilgul shevua? amar rav yehuda amar rav: deamar leh: "hishshava li sheen avdi atta".
Hahu shammote meshammetinan leh! detanya: hakkore lachavero "eved" – yehe benidduy. "mamzer" – sofeg et haarbaim. "rasha" – yored immo lechayyav!
Ella amar rava: hishshava li shello nimkarta li beeved ivri. hay taanta meallayyta hi, mamona it leh gabbeh! rava letameh, deamar rava: eved ivri gufo kanuy.
I hachi, hayeynu karka! mahu detema: karka hu deavdi inashe dimzabbeni betzina, im ita dezabben – let leh kala.
Hay, im ita dezabben – kala it leh, ka mashma lan.
Mishna kol hannaase damim beacher, kevan shezzacha ze – nitchayyev ze bachalifav. ketzad? hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor, kevan shezzacha ze – nitchayyev ze bachalifav.
Gemara chalifin may nihu? – matbea, shema minna: matbea naase chalifin? amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar: kol hannishshom damim beacher,
b: Kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev bachalifin. dayka name, dekatane: ketzad? hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor. shema minna.

Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara dematbea naase chalifin, may ketzad? hachi kaamar: perot name avdi chalifin. ketzad? hechlif besar shor befara o besar chamor beshor, kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev bachalifin.
Hanicha lerav sheshet, deamar: perot avdi chalifin. ella lerav nachman deamar: perot la avdi chalifin, may ikka lememar?
Hachi kaamar: yesh damim shehen kachalifin, ketzad? hechlif deme shor befara o deme chamor beshor.
May tama? savar la kerabbi yochanan, deamar: devar tora, maot konot. uma taam amru meshicha kona? gezera shemma yomar lo: "nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay".
Milleta dishchicha[1] gezaru ba rabbanan, milleta dela shechicha[1] la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Uleresh lakish deamar: meshicha meforeshet min hattora, hanicha i savar la kerav sheshet deamar perot avdi chalifin, metaretz kerav sheshet.
Ella i savar la kerav nachman deamar perot la avdi chalifin, umatbea la kane, bemay moke la? al kurchach, kerav sheshet sevira leh.
Mishna reshut haggavoah bechesef, ureshut hahedyot bachazaka. amirato legavoah – kimsirato lehedyot.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: ketzad reshut haggavoah bechesef? gizbar shennatan maot bivhema, afillu behema besof haolam – kana. uvahedyot – lo kana ad sheyyimshoch.
Ketzad amirato laggavoah kimsirato lahedyot? haomer "shor ze ola", "bayit ze hekdesh", afillu besof haolam – kana. bahedyot – lo kana

a: Ad sheyyimshoch veyachzik. meshacho bemane velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bematayim – noten matayim. may tama – "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".
Meshacho bematayim, velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bemane – noten matayim. may tama – lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mehekdesh.

Pedao bematayim, velo hispik lemoshcho ad sheamad bemane – noten matayim, may tama – "venatan hakkesef vekam lo". pedao bemane velo hispik lemoshcho ad sheamad bematayim – ma sheppada paduy, veen noten ella mane.
Ammay? hachi name nema: lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mehekdesh?
Attu hedyot lav bemi sheppara kae?

Mishna kol mitzvot habben al haav anashim chayyayvin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvot haav al habben – echad anashim veechad nashim chayyayvin. vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah – anashim chayyayvin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah – echad haanashim veechad hannashim chayyayvin.
Vechol mitzvot lo taase, ben shehazzeman geramah ben shello hazzeman geramah – echad haanashim veechad hannashim chayyayvin, chutz mibbal takkif" uval tashchit", uval tittamme lemetim".

Gemara may "kol mitzvot habben al haav"? illema kol mitzvot demichayyayv bera lemibad leabba, nashim peturot? vehatanya: "ish" – en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer: "ish immo veaviv tirau", hare kan shenayim!
Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar: kol mitzvot habben hammuttalot al haav laasot livno – anashim chayyayvin venashim peturot.

Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: haav chayyayv bivno lemulo, velifdoto, ulelammedo tora, ulehassio ishsha, ulelammedo ummanut. veyesh omrim: af lahashito bammayim. rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheeno melammed et beno ummanut – melammedo listut. listut salka datach? ella: keillu melammedo listut.

"Lemulo" menalan? dichtiv: "vayyamol avraham et yitzchak beno". vehecha dela mahleh avu michayyeyvi be dina lemimhaleh, dichtiv: "himmol lachem kol zachar". vehecha dela mahlu be dina michayyayv ihu lemimhal nafsheh, dichtiv: "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar orlato venichreta".
Ihi menalan dela michayyeyva? dichtiv: "kaasher tzivva oto elohim" – oto velo otah.
Ashkechan miyyad, ledorot menalan? tana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar: "tzav" eno ella zeruz, miyyad uledorot.
Zeruz, dichtiv: "vetzav et yehoshua vechazzekehu veammetzehu". miyyad uledorot, dichtiv: "min hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem"
Lifdoto. menalan? dichtiv: "kol bechor banecha tifde". vehecha dela parkeh avu michayyayv ihu lemifrekeh dichtiv: (pado) "tippade".
Veihi menalan dela mippakda? dichtiv: "tippade" – "tifde", kol shemmetzuvvev lifdot et atzmo – metzuvvev lifdot et acherim, vechol sheeno metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo – eno metzuvvev lifdot acherim.

Veihi menalan dela michayyeyva lemifrak nafsha? dichtiv: "tifde" – "tippade", kol sheacherim metzuvvivym lifdoto – metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo, vechol sheen acherim metzuvvivym lifdoto – en metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo. uminnayin sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lifdotah? deamar kera: "kol bechor banecha tifde" – banecha velo benotecha.
Tanu rabbanan: hu lifdot uveno lifdot – hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: beno kodmo. shezze mitzvato al aviv, veze mitzvat beno alav.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hakkol modin
b: Kol hecha delekka ella chamesh selaim – hu kodem livno. may tama? mitzva degufeh adifa. ki peligi hecha deikka chamesh meshuebadim vechamesh bene chorin.
Rabbi yehuda savar: milva (dichtiv) [hakketuva] battora kichtuva bishtar damya, behane chamesh parek livreh veazel kohen vetaref leh lechamesh meshuebadim ledideh.
Verabbanan savri: milva dichtiv beorayyta lav kichtuva bishtar damya, vehilkach mitzva degufeh adif.
Tanu rabbanan: lifdot et beno velaalot laregel – pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel. rabbi yehuda omer: ole laregel, veachar kach pode et beno. shezzo mitzva overet, vezo mitzva sheenah overet.
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, kidkaamar tama. ella rabbanan may tamayyhu? deamar kera: "kol bechor banecha tifde", vahadar: "lo yerau fanay rekam".
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim hayu lo chamishsha banim mechamesh nashim shechayyayv lifdot kullan – talmud lomar: "kol bechor banecha tifde". peshita, befeter rechem tela rachamana!
Mahu detema: nelaf bechor bechor minnachala, ma lehallan "reshit ono", af kan "reshit ono", ka mashma lan.
Lelammedo tora. menalan? dichtiv: "velimmadtem otam et benechem". vehecha dela agmereh avu michayyayv ihu lemigmar nafsheh, dichtiv: "ulemadtem".
Ihi menalan dela michayyeyva? dichtiv: "velimmadtem" "ulemadtem", kol shemmetzuvvev lilmod – metzuvvev lelammed, vechol sheeno metzuvvev lilmod – eno metzuvvev lelammed.

Veihi menalan dela michayyeyva lemelaf nafsha? dichtiv: "velimmadtem" "ulemadtem", kol sheacherim metzuvvivyn lelammedo – metzuvvev lelammed et atzmo, vechol sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lelammedo – en metzuvvev lelammed et atzmo. uminnayin sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lelammedah? deamar kera: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" et benechem, velo benotechem.

Tanu rabbanan: hu lilmod uveno lilmod – hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: im beno zariz umemullach vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado – beno kodmo. ki ha derav yaakov bereh derav acha bar yaakov shaddereh avu lekammeh deabbaye. ki ata chazyeh dela hava michaddedan shemateh. amar leh: ana adifa minnach, tuv at, deezil ana.
Shema abbaye deka hava ate. hava hahu mazzik be rabbanan deabbaye, dechi havo ayyli bitren afillu bimama havo mittazzeki. amar lehu: la littev leh inash ushepiza, efshar demitrechish nissa.
Al, bat behahu be rabbanan. iddemi leh ketannina deshiva reshvoteh. kol keria dichra netar chad resheh. amar lehu limchar: i la itrechish nissa sakkentin.

Tanu rabbanan: lilmod tora velissa ishsha – yilmod tora veachar kach yissa ishsha. veim i efshar lo belo ishsha – yissa ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha, nose ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora.
Rabbi yochanan amar: rechayim betzavvaro veyaasok battora?! vela peligi: ha – lan, veha – lehu.

Mishtabbach leh rav chisda lerav huna bidrav hamenuna deadam gadol hu. amar leh: kesheyyavo leyadcha – haviehu leyadi. ki ata chazyeh dela pares sudara. amar leh: may tama la paresat sudara? amar leh: dela nesevna. ahderinhu leappeh minneh. amar leh: chazi dela chazet lehu leappay ad denasvat.
Rav huna letameh deamar: ben esrim shana velo nasa ishsha – kol yamav baavera. baavera salka datach?! ella ema: kol yamav behirhur avera.
Amar rava, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: ad esrim shana yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu umetzappe laadam matay yissa ishsha, kevan shehiggia esrim velo nasa, omer: tippach atzmotav.
Amar rav chisda: hay daadifna mechavray, dinsevna beshittesar, vei hava nasevna bearbesar

a: Hava amena lesatan: gira beenaych. amar leh rava lerabbi natan bar amme: addidach al tzavvere divraych. mishshittesar vead esrim vetarte veamri la: mittamne sere ad esrim vearbaa.
Ketannae: "chanoch lannaar al pi darko", rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, chad amar: mishshittesar vead esrim vetarten, vechad amar: mittamne sere vead esrim vearbea.

Ad hechan chayyayv adam lelammed et beno tora? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon zevulun ben dan, shellimmedo avi aviv mikra umishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot. metivi: limmedo mikra – en melammedo mishna, veamar rava: mikra – zo tora!
Kizvulun ben dan, velo kizvulun ben dan. kizvulun ben dan – shellimmedo avi aviv, velo kizvulun ben dan, deillu hatam mikra mishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot, veillu hacha – mikra levad.

Vaavi aviv mi michayyayv? vehatanya: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" – velo bene venechem. uma ani mekayyem: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", lomar lach: shekkol hamelammed et beno tora – maale alav hakkatuv keillu limmedo lo velivno uleven beno, ad sof kol haddorot!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" – en li ella benechem, bene venechem minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha". im ken ma talmud lomar: "benechem" – benechem velo benotechem.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hamelammed et ben beno tora maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbelah mehar sinay, shenneemar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", usemich leh: "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev".

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba ashkecheh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deshade disna aresheh veka mamte leh leyanoka leve chenishta. amar leh: may kulle hay? amar leh: mi zutar may dichtiv: "vehodatam levanecha" usemich leh: "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev"? mikkan veelach, rabbi chiyyay bar abba la taem umetza ad demakre leyanoka umosfeh. rabba bar rav huna la taem umetza ad demayyte leyanoka levet midresha.
Amar rav safra mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: may dichtiv "veshinnantam levanecha" – al tikre "veshinnantam", ella "veshillashtam".
Leolam yeshallesh adam shenotav: shelish bammikra, shelish bammishna, shelish battalmud. mi yodea kamma chaye? la tzericha leyome.

Lefichach nikreu rishonim "sofrim", shehayu sofrim kol haotiyyot shebbattora, shehayu omrim: vav degachon"– chetzyayn shel otiyyot shel sefer tora. "darosh darash" – chetzyayn shel tevot. "vehitgallach" – shel pesukim. "yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar" – ayin deyaar chetzyayn shel tehillim. "vehu rachum yechapper avon" – chetzyo difsukim.

Bae rav yosef: vav "degachon", mehay gisa o mehay gisa? amaru leh: nete sefer tora venimninhu, mi la amar rabba bar bar chana: lo zazu mishsham ad sheheviu sefer tora umenaum? amar lehu: inhu bekii bachaserot viterot, anan la bekiinan.

Bae rav yosef: "vehitgallach", mehay gisa o mehay gisa? amar leh abbaye: pesuke miha layto limninhu! bifsuke name la bekiinan, dechi ata rav acha bar adda, amar: bemareva paski leh lehay kera litlata pesuke: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan".
Tanu rabbanan: chameshet alafim ushemone meot ushemonim ushemona pesukim havu pesuke sefer tora, yater alav tehillim shemona, chaser mimmennu divre hayyamim shemona.
Tanu rabbanan: "veshinnantam", sheyyehu divre tora mechuddadim befich, sheim yishal lecha adam davar al tegamgem vetomar lo, ella emor lo miyyad, shenneemar:
b: "Emor lachochma achoti at vegomer" veomer: "koshrem al etzbeotecha kotvem al luach libbecha", veomer: "kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken bene hanneurim", veomer: "chitztze gibbor shenunim", veomer: "chitztzecha shenunim ammim tachtecha yippelu", veomer: "ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar".

May "et oyvim bashshaar"? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: afillu haav uveno, harav vetalmido sheoskin battora bashshaar echad – naasim oyvim ze et ze. veenam zazim mishsham ad shennaasim ohavim ze et ze shenneemar: "et vahev besufa", al tikre "besufa" ella "besofah".

Tanu rabbanan: "vesamtem" – sam tam, nimshela tora kesam chayyim. mashal leadam shehikka et beno makka gedola vehinniach lo retiyya al makkato, veamar lo: beni, kol zeman shehartiyya zo al makkatcha echol ma shehanaatecha, ushete ma shehanaatecha, urechotz ben bechammin ben betzonen veen atta mityayre. veim atta maavirah hare hi maala nome.
Kach hakkadosh baruch hu amar lahem leyisrael: banay, barati yetzer hara uvarati lo tora tavlin. veim attem oskim battora – en attem nimsarim beyado, shenneemar: "halo im tetiv seet",

Veim en attem oskin battora – attem nimsarim beyado, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz", velo od ella shekkol massao umattano becha, shenneemar: "veelecha teshukato". veim atta rotze atta moshel bo, shenneemar: "veatta timshol bo".

Tanu rabbanan: kashe yetzer hara, sheafillu yotzro kerao ra, shenneemar: "ki yetzer lev haadam ra minneurav". amar rav yitzchak: yitzro shel adam mitchaddesh alav bechol yom, shenneemar: "rak ra kol hayyom".

Veamar rabbi shimon ben levi: yitzro shel adam mitgabber alav bechol yom umevakkesh hamito, shenneemar: "tzofe rasha latztzaddik umevakkesh lahamito", veilmale hakkadosh baruch hu ozro en yachol lo, shenneemar: "elohim lo yaazvennu veyado".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: beni im paga becha menuuol ze – moshchehu levet hammidrash. im even hu – nimmoach, veim barzel hu – mitpotzetz, shenneemar: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchefattish yefotzetz sala". im even hu – nimmoach, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim" veomer: "avanim shachaku mayim".
Lehassio ishsha. menalan? dichtiv: "kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukechu livnechem nashim veet benotechem tenu laanashim".
Bishlama beno – beyado, ella bitto – beyado hi? hachi kaamar lehu: nitten la midde v[na]lebshay unechasseyay ki hechi di[l]kiftzu ala inashe.

Lelammedo ummanut. menalan? amar chizkiyya: deamar kera: "ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta". im "ishsha" mammash hi: keshem shechayyayv lehassio ishsha – kach chayyayv lelammedo ummanut. im tora hi: keshem shechayyayv lelammedo tora – kach chayyayv lelammedo ummanut.
Veyesh omrim af lahashito bannahar. may tama? chayyuteh hu.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheeno melammedo ummanut – melammedo listut. listut salka datach! ella, keillu melammedo listut.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deagmereh iska.

Kol mitzvot haav al habben vechulei. may kol mitzvot haav al habben? illema kol mitzvata demichayyayv abba lemibad livreh nashim chayyayvot – vehatanya: haav chayyayv bivno lemulo velifdoto. aviv – en, immo – lo!

Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: kol mitzvot haav hammuttalot al habben laasot leaviv, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyayvin. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: "ish" – en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer "tirau" – hare kan shenayim.
Im ken ma talmud lomar "ish"? – ish sippek beyado laasot, ishsha en sippek beyadah laasot, mippene shershut acherim aleha. amar rav idi bar avin amar rav: nitgarsha, shenehem shavim.
Tanu rabbanan: neemar: "kabbed et avicha veet immecha", veneemar: "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha", hishva hakkatuv kibbud av vaem lichvod hammakom.
Neemar: "ish immo veaviv tirau", veneemar: "et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod", hishva hakkatuv moraat av vaem lemoraat hammakom.
Neemar: "mekallel aviv veimmo mot yumat", veneemar: "ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto", hishva hakkatuv birkat av vaem levirkat hammakom. aval behakkaa vadday i efshar.

Vechen bedin, sheshshelashtan shuttafin bo. tanu rabbanan: shelosha shuttafin hen baadam: hakkadosh baruch hu, veaviv, veimmo. bizman sheadam mechabbed et aviv veet immo amar hakkadosh baruch hu: maale ani alehem keillu darti benehem, vechibbeduni.
Tanya rabbi omer: galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shebben mechabbed et immo yoter meaviv, mippene

a: Shemmeshaddalto bidvarim, lefichach hikdim hakkadosh baruch hu kibbud av lechibbud em. vegaluy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shehabben mityayre meaviv yoter meimmo, mippene shemmelammedo tora, lefichach hikdim hakkadosh baruch hu mora haem lemora haav.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: bizman sheadam metzaer et aviv veet immo amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yafe asiti shello darti benehem, sheilmale darti benehem, tziaruni. amar rabbi yitzchak: kol haover avera basseter – keillu dochek ragle shechina. shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur leadam sheyyehallech arba ammot bekoma zekufa, shenneemar: "melo chol haaretz kevodo". rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la mesagge arba ammot begilluy harosh. amar: shechina lemala meroshi.

Shaal ben almana achat et rabbi eliezer: abba omer: "hashekeni mayim" veimma omeret: "hashekeni mayim", eze mehem kodem? amar leh: hannach kevod immecha vaase kevod avicha, sheatta veimmecha chayyayvim bichvod avicha. ba lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar lo kach.
Amar lo: rabbi, nitgarsha mahu? amar leh: mibben rise enecha nikkar shebben almana atta. hattel lahen mayim besefel vekakea lahen ketarnegolin.

Daresh ulla rabba appitcha deve nesia: may dichtiv: "yoducha Adonai kol malche aretz ki shamu imre ficha" – "maamar picha" lo neemar, ella "imre ficha" – beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu "anochi" velo yihye lecha", amaru ummot haolam: lichvod atzmo hu doresh.

Kevan sheamar: "kabbed et avicha veet immecha" chazru vehodu lemaamarot harishonot. rava amar: mehacha: "rosh devarcha emet" – "rosh devarcha" velo "sof devarcha"? ella missof devarcha nikkar sherosh devarcha emet.

Beo minneh merav ulla: ad hechan kibbud av vaem? amar lahem: tzeu ureu ma asa nochri echad beashkelon, vedama ben netina shemo. paam achat bikkeshu chachamim perakmatya beshishshim ribbo sachar, vehaya mafteach munnach tachat meraashotav shel aviv, velo tziaro.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shaalu et rabbi eliezer: ad hechan kibbud av vaem? amar lahem: tzeu ureu ma asa nochri echad leaviv beashkelon, vedama ben netina shemo. bikkeshu mimmennu chachamim avanim laefod beshishshim ribbo sachar, verav kahana matne bishmonim ribbo, vehaya mafteach munnach tachat meraashotav shel aviv, velo tziaro.

Leshana haacheret natan hakkadosh baruch hu secharo, shennolda lo para adumma beedro. nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo, amar lahem: yodea ani bachem sheim ani mevakkesh mikkem kol mamon shebbaolam attem notnin li, ella en ani mevakkesh mikkem ella oto mamon shehifsadti bishvil kevod abba.
Veamar rabbi chanina: uma mi sheeno metzuvvev veose – kach, metzuvvev veose – al achat kamma vechamma. deamar rabbi chanina: gadol metzuvvev veose mimmi sheeno metzuvvev veose.

Amar rav yosef: meresh hava amena: man dahava amar li halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar: some patur min hammitzvot – avedna yoma tava lerabbanan, deha la mippekidna veha avedna. hasheta deshamita leha deamar rabbi chanina: gadol metzuvvev veose yoter mimmi sheeno metzuvvev veose, adderabba: man deamar li deen halacha kerabbi yehuda avedna yoma tava lerabbanan.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: paam achat haya lavush sirkon shel zahav, vehaya yoshev ben gedole romi. uvata immo ukeraattu mimmennu, vetafcha lo al rosho, veyarka lo befanav, velo hichlimah.
Tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu: yesh maachil leaviv pasyone vetordo min haolam, veyesh matchino barechayim
b: Umevio lechayye haolam habba.

Amar rabbi avahu: kegon avimi beri kiyyem mitzvat kibbud. chamsha bene semichi hava leh laavimi bechayye aviv, vechi hava ata rabbi avahu, kare abbava, rahet veazel ufatach leh veamar: in, in, ad dematey hatam.
Yoma chad amar leh: ashkeyayn mayya. addeayyti leh namnem. gachen kae aleh ad deittear. istayyaya milleteh uderash avimi "mizmor leasaf".

Amar leh rav yaakov bar avu leabbaye: kegon ana, dead deatena mibbe rav abba medalle li kasa veimma mazga li, hechi eeved? amar leh: meimmach kabbel, umeavuch la tekabbel dechevan devar tora hu chalsha dateh.

Rabbi tarfon hava leh hahi imma dechol emat dahavat baaya lemesek lefureya gachin uselik la, vechol emat dehvat nachit, nechtat aluya. ata veka mishtabbach be midresha. amre leh: adayin lo higgata lachatzi kibbud. kelum zarka arnaki befanecha layyam velo hichlamtah?

Rav yosef ki hava shama kal kara deimmeh, amar: ekum mikkamme shechina deatya. amar rabbi yochanan: ashre mi shello chamaan. rabbi yochanan ki ibberattu immo – met aviv, yeladattu – meta immo. vechen abbaye. ini? vehaamar abbaye: amara li em! hahi merabbeyanteh havay.
Rav assi hava leh hahi imma zekena. amara leh: baayana tachshitin. avad la. baayana gavra: neyayyen lach. baayana gavra deshappir kevatach, shavka vaazal leara deyisrael.

Shema deka azla abbatreh. ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: mahu latzet meeretz lechutza laaretz? amar leh: asur. likrat imma mahu? amar leh: eni yodea. ittarach pureta, hadar ata. amar leh: assi, nitratztzeta latzet – hammakom yachazircha leshalom.

Ata lekammeh derabbi elazar. amar leh: chas veshalom, dilma mirtach ratach? amar leh: may amar lach? amar leh: hammakom yachazircha leshalom. amar leh: veim ita deratach – la hava mevarech lech. addehachi vehachi shema laarona dekaate. amar: i yedai la nefaki.

Tanu rabbanan: mechabbedo bechayyav, umechabbedo bemoto. bechayyav ketzad? hannishma bidvar aviv lemakom, lo yomar: "shallechuni bishvil atzmi", "maharuni bishvil atzmi", "pitruni bishvil atzmi". ella kullehu: "bishvil abba".

Bemoto ketzad? haya omer davar shemua mippiv, lo yomar: "kach amar abba", ella: "kach amar abba mari, hareni kapparat mishkavo". vehane mille toch shenem asar chodesh, mikkan veelach omer: "zichrono livracha lechayye haolam habba".
Tanu rabbanan: chacham – meshanne shem aviv veshem rabbo. turegman – eno meshanne lo shem aviv velo shem rabbo. avu deman? ilema avu dimturegman – attu turegman lav bar chiyyuva hu?
Ella amar rava: shem aviv shel chacham, veshem rabbo shel chacham. ki ha demar bar rav ashe ki hava daresh befirka, ihu amar: abba mari, veamoreh amar: hachi amar rav ashe.
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu mora veezehu kibbud? mora – lo omed bimkomo, velo yoshev bimkomo, velo soter et devarav, velo machrio. kibbud – maachil umashke, malbish umechasse, machnis umotzi.
Ibbaya lehu:

a: Mishshel mi? rav yehuda amar: mishshel ben. rav natan bar oshaya amar: mishshel av. oro leh rabbanan lerav yirmeya, veamri la livreh derav yirmeya, keman deamar mishshel av.

Metivi: neemar: "kabbed et avicha veet immecha", veneemar: "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha". ma lehallan bechesron kis, af kan bechesron kis. vei amrat mishshel av, may nafka leh minneh? levittul melacha.
Ta shema: shene achim, shene shuttafin haav uveno, harav vetalmido – podin ze laze maaser sheni, umaachilin ze laze masar ani.
Vei amrat mishshel ben, nimtza ze porea chovo mishshel aniyyim! – la tzericha, lehaedafa.
I hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala: amar rabbi yehuda: tavo meera lemi shemmaachil et aviv masar ani. vei lehaedafa, may nafka minna?! afillu hachi zila beh milleta.

Ta shema: shaalu et rabbi eliezer ad hechan kibbud av vaem? amar lahem: kede sheyyittol arnaki veyizrekennu layyam befanav veeno machlimo. vei amrat mishshel av, may nafka leh minneh? berauy leyorsho.
Vechi ha derabba bar rav huna. derav huna kera shirae beanpe rabba bereh. amar: ezil ichze i ratach i la ratach. vedilma ratach vekaavar allifne ivver lo titten michshol"! demachel leh likareh.
Veha kaavar mishshum "bal tashchit"! daavad leh befumebyayne. vedilma mishshum hachi la ratach? deaved leh bishat ritcheh.
Matne leh rav yechezkel lerami bereh: hannisrafim banniskalim, rabbi shimon omer: yiddonu biskila, shehasserefa chamura.
Amar leh rav yehuda bereh: abba, la taytneyeh hachi. may irya serefa chamura, tippok li derubba niskalim ninhu! ella hachi aytneyeh: hanniskalim bannisrafim.
Amar leh: i hachi ema sefa: vachachamim omrim yiddonu bisrefa, shehassekila chamura. may irya diskila chamura? tippok li derubba nisrafim ninhu!
Amar leh: hatam rabbanan hu dekaamru leh lerabbi shimon: dekaamrat serefa chamura – la, sekila chamura.

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, la tema leh laavuch hachi. detanya: hare shehaya aviv over al divre tora, al yomar lo "abba avarta al divre tora", ella omer lo: "abba kach katuv battora". "kach katuv battora" – tzaore ka metzaar leh! ella omer lo: "abba, mikra katuv battora kach".

Elazar ben matya omer: abba omer: "hashekeni mayim", umitzva laasot – manniach ani kevod abba, veose et hammitzva. sheani veabba chayyayvim bammitzva. isi ben yehuda omer: im efshar lammitzva leasot al yede acherim – tease al yede acherim, veyelech hu bichvod aviv. amar rav matna: halacha keisi ben yehuda.
Amar rav yitzchak bar shela amar rav matna amar rav chisda: haav shemmachal al kevodo – kevodo machul. harav shemmachal al kevodo – en kevodo machul.

Verav yosef amar: afillu harav shemmachal al kevodo – kevodo machul. shenneemar: "vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam". amar rava: hachi hasheta?! hatam, hakkadosh baruch hu alma dileh hu, vetora dileh hi – machel leh likareh,
b: Hacha tora dileh hi?! hadar amar rava: in, tora dileh hi, dichtiv: "uvetorato yehge yomam valayla".

Ini?! veha rava mashke be hillula divreh vedal leh kasa lerav pappa ulerav huna bereh derav yehoshua, vekamu mikkammeh. lerav mari ulerav pinchas bereh derav chisda, vela kamu mikkammeh. ikkefad vaamar: hanu rabbanan rabbanan, vehanu rabbanan lav rabbanan?
Vetu, rav pappa hava mashke be hillula deabba mar bereh vedalli leh kasa lerabbi yitzchak bereh derav yehuda vela kam mikkammeh veikkefad! afillu hachi – hiddur mebad leh bau.

Amar rav ashe: afillu leman deamar: harav shemmachal al kevodo – kevodo machul, nasi shemmachal al kevodo – en kevodo machul. metivi: maase berabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok shehayu mesubbin bevet hammishte beno shel rabban gamliel, vehaya rabban gamliel omed umashke alehem. natan hakkos lerabbi eliezer velo netalo, netano lerabbi yehoshua vekibbelo. amar lo rabbi eliezer: ma ze yehoshua? anu yoshvin verabban gamliel beribbi omed umashke alenu?!

Amar leh: matzinu gadol mimmennu sheshshimmesh, avraham gadol mimmennu – veshimmesh. avraham gedol haddor haya, vechatuv bo: "vehu omed alehem". veshemma tomru: kemalache hashsharet nidmu lo – lo nidmu lo ella learviyyim. veanu, lo yehe rabban gamliel beribbi omed umashke alenu?!

Amar lahem rabbi tzadok: ad matay attem mannichim kevodo shel makom veattem oskim bichvod habberiyyot? hakkadosh baruch hu meshiv ruchot, umaale nesiim, umorid matar, umatzmiach adama, veorech shulechan lifne kol echad veechad, veanu lo yehe rabban gamliel beribbi omed umashke alenu?

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav ashe: afillu leman deamar: nasi shemmachal al kevodo – kevodo machul, melech shemmachal al kevodo – en kevodo machul, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech" – shettehe emato alecha.

Tanu rabbanan: "mippene seva takum" – yachol afillu mippene zaken ashmay? talmud lomar: "zaken", veen zaken ella chacham, shenneemar: "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael". rabbi yose haggelili omer: en zaken ella mi shekkana chochma, shenneemar: "Adonai kanani reshit darko".
Yachol yaamod mippanav mimmakom rachok? talmud lomar: "takum vehadarta" – lo amarti kima ella bimkom sheyyesh hiddur.

Yachol yehadderennu bemamon? talmud lomar: "takum vehadarta" – ma kima sheen bah chesron kis, af hiddur sheen bo chesron kis. yachol yaamod mippanav mibbet hakkisse umibbet hammerchatz? talmud lomar: "takum vehadarta" – lo amarti kima ella bimkom sheyyesh hiddur.
Yachol yaatzim enav kemi shello raahu? talmud lomar: "takum... veyareta" – davar hammasur lallev neemar bo: "veyareta meelohecha".
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: minnayin lezaken shello yatriach? talmud lomar: "zaken veyareta". isi ben yehuda omer: "mippene seva takum" – afillu kol seva bammashma.
Rabbi yose haggelili hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu yannik vechakkim. tanna kamma savar: yannik vechakkim – la, rabbi yose haggelili savar: afillu yannik vechakkim.

May tama derabbi yose haggelili? amar lach: i salka datach kidkaamar tanna kamma – im ken nichtov rachamana: "mippene seva zaken takum vehadarta", may shena defalginhu rachamana – lememar: dehay lav hay, vehay lav hay. shema minna afillu yannik vechakkim.
Vetanna kamma, mishshum devae lemismach "zaken" "veyareta". vetanna kamma may tama? i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi yose haggelili – im ken nichtov rachamana:

a: "Mippene seva takum vehadarta, takum vehadarta pene zaken" umiddela ketav hachi, shema minna chad hu.

Amar mar: yachol yehadderennu bemamon? talmud lomar: "takum vehadarta" – ma kima sheen bah chesron kis – af hiddur sheen bo chesron kis. vekima let ba chesron kis? mi la askinan deka nakev marganita, addehachi vehachi kaem mikkammeh uvatel mimmelachto!

Ella: akkesh kima lehiddur. ma hiddur sheen bo bittul – af kima sheen bah bittul. veakkesh name hiddur lekima, ma kima sheen bah chesron kis – af hiddur sheen bo chesron kis. mikkan amru: en baale ummaniyyot rashshain laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtam.

Vela? vehatnan: kol baale ummaniyyot omdim mippenehem, veshoalim bishlomam, veomrim lahem: achenu anshe makom peloni boachem leshalom! amar rabbi yochanan: mippenehem omdim, mippene talmide chachamim en omdim.
Amar rabbi yose bar avin: bo uree kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah, shehare mippenehem omdim, mippene talmide chachamim en omdim. vedilma shane hatam, deim ken, atta machshilan leatid lavo.

Amar mar: yachol yaamod mippanav mibbet hakkisse umibbet hammerchatz. vela? veha rabbi chiyyay hava yatev be maschuta vechalef veazel rabbi shimon bar rabbi, vela kam mikkammeh veikkefad, vaata amar leh laavu: shene chummashim shaniti lo besefer tehillim, velo amad mippanay!

Vetu: bar kappara, veamri la rabbi shemuel bar rabbi yose, hava yatev be maschuta. al veazel rabbi shimon bar rabbi vela kam mikkammeh, veikkefad, vaata amar leh laavu: shene shelishe shelish shaniti lo betorat kohanim – velo amad mippanay! veamar lo: shemma bahen yoshev umeharher.
Tama devahen yoshev umeharher, ha lav hachi la!
La kashya: ha bevatte gavvae, ha bevatte barae.
Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom muttar lehareher chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse. dilma leuneseh shane.
Yachol yaatzim enav kemi shello raahu. attu berashshie askinan?
Ella: yachol yaatzim enav mikkamme delimteye zeman chiyyuva, dechi meta zeman chiyyuva ha la chaze leh dekaem mikkammeh, talmud lomar: "takum veyareta".
Tana: ezohi kima sheyyesh bah hiddur – heve omer ze arba ammot. amar abbaye: la amaran ella berabbo sheeno muvehak, aval berabbo hammuvehak – melo enav.

Abbaye mikki hava chaze leh leudeneh dechamra derav yosef deate, hava kaem. abbaye hava rechiv chamara veka mesagge aggudda dinhar sagya, yatev rav mesharsheya verabbanan beiddach gisa vela kamu mikkammeh. amar lehu: velav rav muvehak ana? amaru leh: lav addatin.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: minnayin lezaken shello yatriach – talmud lomar: "zaken veyareta". amar abbaye: naktinan dei makkef – chaye. abbaye makkef, rabbi zera makkef.
Ravina hava yatev kammeh derabbi yirmeya middifti, chalaf hahu gavra kammeh vela mikkasse resha. amar: kamma chatzif ha gavra. amar leh: dilma mimmata machseya nihu, degisi ba rabbanan.

Isi ben yehuda omer: "mippene seva takum" – vaafillu kol seva bammashma. amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keisi ben yehuda. rabbi yochanan hava kae mikkamme save dearmae. amar: kamma harepatke ado alayyhu dehane. rava mekam la kae, hiddur aved lehu.
Abbaye yahev yeda lesave. rava meshaddar shelucheh. rav nachman meshaddar gozae. amar: i lav tora kamma nachman bar abba ikka beshuka?
Amar rabbi ayyvu amar rabbi yannay:
b: En talmid chacham rashshay laamod mippene rabbo ella shacharit vearvit, kede shello yihye kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim. metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: minnayin lezaken shello yatriach – talmud lomar: "zaken veyareta".
Vei amrat shacharit vearvit bilvad, ammay la nitrach? chiyyuva hu! ella lav kulle yoma! la, leolam shacharit vearvit bilvad, vaafillu hachi kamma deefshar leh – la nitrach.

Amar rabbi elazar: kol talmid chacham sheen omed mippene rabbo nikra rasha, veeno maarich yamim, vetalmudo mishtakkeach, shenneemar: "vetov lo yihye larasha velo yaarich yamim katztzel asher enennu yare millifne haelohim", mora zo eni yodea mahu – keshehu omer "veyareta meelohecha" – hare mora zo kima.
Veema moraat ribbit umoraat mishkalot! rabbi elazar: "pene" "pene" gamar.

Ibbaya lehu: beno vehu rabbo, mahu laamod mippene aviv? ta shema, daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, kum mikkamme avuch. shane rav yechezkel devaal maasim hava, daafillu mar shemuel name kaem mikkammeh.
Ella may kaamar leh? hachi kaamar leh: zimnin deate meachoray, kum at mikkammeh vela techush likara didi.
Ibbaya lehu: beno vehu rabbo, mahu sheyyaamod aviv mippanav? ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ani eni keday laamod mippene veni, ella mishshum kevod bet nasi.
Tama daana rabbeh, ha ihu rabbay – kaemna mikkammeh! hachi kaamar: ani eni keday laamod mippene veni vaafillu hu rabbay, deha ana avu, ella mishshum kevod bet nasi.
Ibbaya lehu: rachuv kimhallech dame, o la? amar abbaye: ta shema: tame yoshev tachat hailan, vetahor omed – tame.
Tame omed tachat hailan vetahor yoshev – tahor, veim yashav hattame – hattahor tame.
Vechen beeven hamenuggaat. veamar rav nachman bar kohen: zot omeret rachuv kimhallech dame, shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu laamod mippene sefer tora? rabbi chilkiyya verabbi simon verabbi elazar amri: kal vachomer, mippene lomdeha omdim – mippaneha lo kol shekken?!
Rabbi ilay verabbi yaakov bar zavdi havo yatvi. chalef veazel rabbi shimon bar abba, vekamu mikkammeh. amar lehu: chada – deattun chakkime vaana chaver. veod, kelum tora omedet mippene lomdeha.
Savar la kerabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: en talmid chacham rashshay laamod mippene rabbo beshaa sheosek battora. layet ala abbaye.
"Vehibbitu achare moshe ad boo haohela", rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha. chad amar lignay, vechad amar leshevach. man deamar lignay – kidita. man deamar leshevach, amar chizkiyya:

Amar li rabbi chanina bereh derabbi avahu, amar rabbi avahu, amar rabbi avdimi demin chefa: chacham over – omed millefanav arba ammot, vechevan sheavar arba ammot – yoshev. av bet din over – omed millefanav melo enav, vechevan sheavar arba ammot yoshev. nasi over – omed millefanav melo enav, veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo, shenneemar: "vehibbitu achare moshe ad boo haohela".
Kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezohi mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah – sukka, velulav, shofar, vetzitzit,

a: Utefillin.
Veezohi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah – mezuza, maake, aveda, veshilluach hakken.

Uchelala hu? hare matztza, simcha, hakehel, demitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama, venashim chayyayvot! vetu: vahare talmud tora, periyya ureviyya, ufidyon habben delav mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah hu – venashim peturot!
Amar rabbi yochanan: en lemedin min hakkelalot, vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo "chutz",
Ditnan: bakkol mearvin umishtattefin chutz min hammayim umelach, vetu lekka? vehaikka kemehin ufitriyyot! ella en lemedin min hakkelalot, vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo "chutz".

Umitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot menalan? – gamar mittefillin, ma tefillin nashim peturot – af kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot. utefillin? – gamar la mittalmud tora, ma talmud tora nashim peturot – af tefillin nashim peturot.
Venakkesh tefillin limzuza! tefillin letalmud tora ittakkush, ben befarasha rishona ben befarasha sheniyya, tefillin limzuza befarasha sheniyya la ittakkush.
Venakkesh mezuza letalmud tora! la salka datach, dichtiv: "lemaan yirbu yemechem", gavre bau chayye, neshe la bau chayye?!
Vahare sukka demitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, dichtiv "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim", tama dichtav rachamana haezrach lehotzi et hannashim, ha lav hachi nashim chayyayvot!
Amar abbaye: itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil dichtiv "bassukkot teshvu" – "teshvu" keen taduru: ma dira ish veishto – af sukka ish veishto.
Verava amar:
b: Itzterich, salka datach amena: nelaf "chamishsha asar" "chamishsha asar" mechag hammatztzot, ma lehallan nashim chayyayvot – af kan nashim chayyayvot, tzericha.
Vahare reiyya, demitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, vetama dichtav rachamana "zechurecha" – lehotzi hannashim, ha lav hachi nashim chayyayvot!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: nelaf "reiyya" "reiyya" mehakehel.
Veaddeyalfinan mittefillin liftura, nelaf missimcha lechiyyuva! amar abbaye: ishsha baalah mesammechah.
Almana may ikka lememar? bishruya etzlo.
Venelaf mehakehel! mishshum dehave matztza vehakehel shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad – en melammedim.
I hachi, tefillin ureiyya name shene chetuvim habbaim keechad – veen melammedim! tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana tefillin vela ketav reiyya, hava amena: nelaf reiyya reiyya mehakehel.
Vei ketav rachamana reiyya vela ketav tefillin, hava amena: akkesh tefillin limzuza, tzericha.
I hachi, matztza vehakehel name tzerichi! lemay tzerichi? bishlama i ketav rachamana hakehel vela ketav matztza, hava amena: nelaf "chamishsha asar" "chamishsha asar" mechag hassukkot.
Ella nichtov rachamana matztza, vela bae hakehel, vaana amena: tefalim chayyayvim, nashim lo kol shekken?! hilkach, have lehu shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, veen melammedim.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar?
Vetu: mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah nashim chayyayvot menalan? deyalef mimmora, ma mora nashim chayyayvot – af kol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama nashim chayyayvot.
Venelaf mittalmud tora! – mishshum dehave leh talmud tora uferiyya ureviyya shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedim.

a: Ulerabbi yochanan ben beroka, deamar: al shenehem hu omer: "vayvarech otam elohim peru urevu" may ikka lememar? mishshum dehave talmud tora ufidyon habben shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin.

Ulerabbi yochanan ben beroka name, nihvo periyya ureviyya umora shene chetuvim habbaim keechad veen melammedin! tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana mora, vela ketav periyya ureviyya, hava amena: "vechivshuha" amar rachamana – ish dedarko lechabbesh – in, ishsha deen darkah lechabbesh – la.
Vei ketav periyya ureviyya velo ketav mora, hava amena: ish desippek beyado laasot – in, ishsha deen sippek beyadah laasot – la, vechevan deen sippek beyadah laasot lo titchayyev kelal, tzericha.
Hanicha leman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar? amar rava: pappunae yadi la letama deha milleta.

Umannu – rav acha bar yaakov: amar kera: "vehaya lecha leot al yadcha ulezikkaron ben enecha lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha" – hukkesha kol hattora kullah litfillin, ma tefillin mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, venashim peturot – af kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah – nashim peturot. umiddemitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah – nashim peturot, mikkelal demitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah – nashim chayyayvot.

Hanicha leman deamar tefillin mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, ella leman deamar tefillin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah, may ikka lememar? man shamat leh deamar tefillin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah – rabbi meir, vesavar la shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin.

Ulerabbi yehuda deamar: shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin, utefillin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah, may ikka lememar? mishshum dehavey matztza, simcha, vehakehel shelosha chetuvim habbaim keechad, ushelosha chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin.

Vechol mitzvat lo taase vechulei. menahane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: amar kera: "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashim shebbattora.

Deve rabbi eliezer tana: amar kera: "asher tasim lifnehem" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol dinim shebbattora. deve chizkiyya tana: amar kera: "vehemit ish o ishsha" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol mitot shebbattora.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta, mishshum kappara chas rachamana ala, aval dinin, ema: ish, devar massa umattan – in, ishsha – la.
Vei ashmevinan ha, mishshum dechayyuta hi, aval kofer ema:
b: Ish, devar mitzvot – in, ishsha – la. vei ashmeinan ha: mishshum deikka ibbud neshama chas rachamana ala, aval hanach tarte – ema la, tzericha.
Chutz mibbal takkif" uval tashchit" kulei. bishlama "bal tittamme lemetim", dichtiv: "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon" – bene aharon, velo benot aharon. ella "bal takkif" uval tashchit" menalan?
Dichtiv: "lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha" – kol sheyyeshno behashechata yeshno behakkafa. vehane neshe, hoil vela itanhu behashechata, letanhu behakkafa.
Umenalan dela itanhu behashechata? ibbaet ema sevara: deha la it lehu zakan. veibbaet ema kera: deamar kera: "lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha",
Middeshanni kera bedibbureh, deim ken nichtov rachamana: "peat zekanchem". may "zekanecha" – zekanecha, velo zekan ishtecha.
Vela? vehatanya: zekan ishsha, vehassaris sheheelu sear – hare hen kezakan lechol divrehem. may lav lehashechata?
Amar abbaye: lehashechata la matzet amrat, deyalef "peat" "peat" mibbene aharon, ma lehallan nashim peturot – af kan nashim peturot.

Vei sevira lan dechi ketiv "bene aharon" – akkulleh inyana ketiv, nishtok kera minneh vetete bekal vachomer, vaana amena: uma kohanim sheribba bahem hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot – "bene aharon" – velo benot aharon, yisrael lo kol shekken?
I lav gezera shava hava amena: hifsik hainyan.
Hasheta name nema hifsik hainyan! vei mishshum gezera shava, mibbee leh lechidtanya: "lo yegallechu", yachol gillecho bemisparayim yihye chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lo tashchit".
Yachol likketo bemalket uverahitne yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lo yegallechu". ha ketzad? gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata, heve omer ze taar.
Im ken, nichtov kera: "et shebbizkanecha", may "peat zekanecha" – shema minna tarte.
Veella ha detanya: zekan haishsha vehassaris sheheelu sear hare hen kezakan lechol divrehem, lemay hilcheta? amar mar zutera: letumeat negaim.
Tumeat negaim behedya ketiva, "veish o ishsha ki yihye vo naga berosh o vezakan"! ella amar mar zutera: letohorat negaim.

Tohorat negaim name peshita, kevan devat tumea hi – bat tohora hi! itzterich, salka datach amena litzdadim ketiv: "ish o ishsha ki yihye vo naga berosh", "o vezakan" – hadar atan leish, ka mashma lan.

Isi tane: af "bal yikrechu" – nashim peturot. may tama deisi dedaresh hachi? "banim attem laAdonai elohechem lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet. ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha", banim velo banot – lekorcha.
Atta omer lekorcha, o eno ella ligdida? keshehu omer: "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha" – hare gedida amur, ha ma ani mekayyem banim velo banot – lekorcha.
Uma raita lerabbot et haggedida ulehotzi et hakkorcha? merabbe ani et haggedida, sheyyeshnah bimkom hassear veshello bimkom sear, umotzi ani et hakkorcha sheenah ella bimkom sear.
Veema: banim velo banot – ben lekorcha ben ligdida, vechi ketiv: "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha", bisrita hu dichtiv! kasavar isi serita ugedida

a: Achat hi.
Abbaye amar: hayeynu tama deisi, degamar "korcha" "korcha" mibbene aharon, ma lehallan nashim peturot – af kan nashim peturot.

Vei sevira lan dechi ketiv kera, bechulle inyayna hu dichtiv, nishtok kera minneh vetete bekal vachomer, vaana amena: uma kohanim sheribba bahem hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot – "bene aharon" – velo benot aharon, yisrael lo kol shekken?
I lav gezera shava hava amena: hifsik hainyan.

Hasheta name nema hifsik hainyan, vei mishshum gezera shava – mibbee leh lechidtanya: "lo yikrechu", yachol afillu karach arba vechamesh kerachot lo yehe chayyayv ella achat? talmud lomar: "korcha" – lechayyev al kol achat veachat.

"Berosham" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet", yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al ben haenayim, minnayin lerabbot kol harosh? talmud lomar: "berosham" – lechayyev al harosh keven haenayim.

Veen li ella kohanim, sheribba bahem hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot, yisrael menalan? – neemar kan: "korcha" veneemar lehallan: "korcha", ma kan chayyayv al kol korcha vekorcha, vechayyayv al harosh keven haenayim – af lehallan chayyayv al kol korcha vekorcha, vechayyayv al harosh keven haenayim.
Uma lehallan al met, af kan al met. im ken nichtov kera "korach", may "korcha" – shamat minna tarte.
Rava amar: hayeynu tama deisi, deyalef "ben enechem" mittefillin, ma lehallan nashim peturot, af kan nashim peturot. verava may tama la amar keabbayye? "korach" "korcha" la mashma leh.
Veabbaye may tama la amar kerava? amar lach: tefillin gufayyhu mehacha gamar la: ma lehallan mekom sheosim korcha, begovah shel rosh, af kan mekom hannacha begova harosh.

Uven leabbaye uven lerava, hay "banim attem", may darshi beh? hay mibbee lechidtanya: "banim attem laAdonai elohechem", bizman sheattem nohagim minhag banim – attem keruyim banim, en attem nohagim minhag banim – en attem keruyim banim, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi meir omer: ben kach uven kach attem keruyim banim, shenneemar: "banim sechalim hemma", veomer: "banim lo emun bam", veomer: "zera mereim banim mashchitim", veomer: "vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: sechale hu demikkeru bene, ki let behu hemanutayyhu la mikkeru bene – ta shema, veomer: "banim lo emun bam",

Vechi tema: ki let behu hemanuta hu demikkeru banim, ki palchu laavoda zara la mikkeru banim – ta shema, veomer: "zera mereim banim mashchitim". vechi tema: "banim mashchitim" hu demikkeru, bene mealleyay la mikkeru – ta shema, veomer: "vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay".

Mishna, hassemichot, vehattenufot, vehahaggashot, vehakkemitzot, veah[ha]ketarot, vehammelikot, vehakkabbalot, vehazzaot – nohagim baanashim velo benashim, chutz mimminchat sota unezira shehen menifot.
Gemara semichot. dichtiv: "dabber el bene yisrael... vesamach" – bene yisrael somchim, veen benot yisrael somchot.
Tenufot. "dabber el bene yisrael... vehenif" – bene yisrael menifin, veen benot yisrael menifot.
Haggashot. dichtiv: "vezot torat hammincha... hakerev otah bene aharon" – bene aharon, velo benot aharon.
Kemitzot. dichtiv: "veheviah el bene aharon vekamatz" – bene aharon, velo benot aharon.
Haketarot. dichtiv: "vehiktiru oto bene aharon" – bene aharon, velo benot aharon.
Hammelikot. dichtiv: "umalak... vehiktir", ittakkash melika lehaketara.
Hakkabbalot. dichtiv: "vehikrivu bene aharon", veamar mar:
b: "Vehikrivu" – zo kabbalat haddam.
Vehazzaot. hazzaa dehecha? i defara, "elazar" ketiv ba. i defanim, "hakkohen hammashiach" ketiv ba. ella hazzaa deven of,
Deatya bekal vachomer mibben tzon. uma ben tzon shello kava lo kohen lishchitato – kava lo kohen lehazzaato, ben of shekkava lo kohen limlikato – eno din sheyyikba lo lehazzaato?

Chutz mimminchat sota unezira. amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh: la tetev akkarach ad deamrat li leha shemateta: minnayin leminchat sota shetteuna tenufa? menalan?! begufa ketiv: "vehenif et hammincha"! ella: tenufa bivalim menalan?
Atya "yad" "yad" mishshelamim. ketiv hacha: "velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha" uchetiv hatam: "yadav tevienna".
Ma kan kohen – af lehallan kohen, ma lehallan bealim – af kan bealim. ha ketzad? kohen machnis yado tachat yad bealim umenif.
Ashkechan sota, nezira menalan? atya: "kaf" "kaf" missota.
Mishna kol mitzva shehi teluya baaretz – enah noheget ella baaretz, vesheenah teluya baaretz – noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz,

a: Chutz min haorla vechilayim. rabbi eliezer omer: af hechadash.

Gemara may teluya umay sheenah teluya? ilema teluya – dichtiv ba "bia", vesheenah teluya – dela ketiv ba "bia", vahare tefillin ufeter chamor, dichtiv bahen "bia", venohagin ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz!
Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar: kol mitzva shehi chovat hagguf – noheget ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz, chovat karka – enah noheget ella baaretz.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "elle hachukkim" – ellu hammidrashot. "vehammishpatim" – ellu haddinim. "asher tishmerun" – zo mishna. "laasot" – zo maase.

"Baaretz" – yachol kol hammitzvot kullan lo yehu nohagim ella baaretz? talmud lomar: "kol hayyamim asher attem chayyim al haadama". i kol hayyamim, yachol yehu nohagim ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz? talmud lomar: "baaretz".

Achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet – tze ulemad mimma sheamur bainyan: "abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham vegomer" – ma avoda zara meyuchedet, shehi chovat hagguf, venoheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz – af kol shehi chovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz.
Chutz min haorla vehakkilayim. ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer lekulla pelig o lechumera pelig?
Lechumera pelig, vehachi kaamar tanna kamma: chutz min haorla umin hakkilayim, dehilcheta gemiri lah, af al gav deikka lememar chovat karka hi. aval chadash, baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la.
May tama? "moshav" – leachar yerushsha vishiva mashma.
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: af chadash noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. may tama? "moshav" – bechol makom sheattem yoshvim.
O dilma lekulla pelig, vehachi kaamar tanna kamma: chutz min haorla vehakkilayim, dehilcheta gemiri la, vechol shekken chadash, demoshav" – kol makom sheattem yoshvim mashma.
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: chadash eno noheg ella baaretz, demoshav" – leachar yerushsha vishiva mashma. umay "af" – akkammayyta.

Ta shema, deamar abbaye: man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer – rabbi yishmael hi. detanya: lelammedcha, shekkol makom shenneemar bo "moshav" eno ella leachar yerushsha vishiva, divre rabbi yishmael.

Amar lo rabbi akiva: hare shabbat, shenneemar bo "moshavot", venoheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz! amar lo: shabbat kal vachomer atya, ma mitzvot kallot nohagot ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz – shabbat chamira lo kol shekken?
Middeamar abbaye: man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer – rabbi yishmael, shema minna rabbi eliezer lechumera pelig, shema minna.
Mikkede rabbi yishmael ahecha kae? annesachim. binsachim
b: Bia umoshav ketiv behu?! hachi kaamar: lelammed shekkol makom shenneemar bia umoshav eno ella leachar yerushsha vishiva, divre rabbi yishmael.

I hachi, amar lo rabbi akiva: hare shabbat shenneemar bo "moshavot", veamar lo: shabbat kal vachomer hi, nema leh: ana bia umoshav kaamena! chada veod kaamar leh, chada – daana bia umoshav kaamena. veod: deka amrat hare shabbat shenneemar bo "moshavot" – shabbat kal vachomer hi.
Bemay kamippalgi? bekervu nesachim bammidbar ka mippalgi. rabbi yishmael savar: la kervu nesachim bammidbar. verabbi akiva savar: kervu nesachim bammidbar.
Amar abbaye: hay tana deve rabbi yishmael mappek meiddach tana deve rabbi yishmael.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veneemru biot battora setam, ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen leachar yerushsha vishiva, af kol leachar yerushsha vishiva.
Veiddach, mishshum dehave melech uvikkurim shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin.

Veiddach: tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana melech vela ketav bikkurim, hava amena: bikkurim, deka mithane – lealtar. vei ketav bikkurim vela ketav melech, hava amena: melech, dedarko lechabbesh – lealtar.
Veiddach: nichtov rachamana melech vela bae bikkurim, vaana amena: uma melech, dilchabbesh leachar yerushsha vishiva, bikkurim – lo kol shekken?
Veiddach: i ketav hachi hava amena: midde dehave achalla, ka mashma lan.

Vehasheta deamrat chovat hagguf noheget ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz, "moshav" dichtav rachamana gabbe shabbat, lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uveinyana demoadot ketiva, tibbee kiddush ki moadot, ka mashma lan.

"Moshav" dichtav rachamana gabbe chelev vadam, lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uveinyana dekorbanot ketivi, bizman deikka korban, nittesar chelev vadam, bizman delekka korban – la, ka mashma lan.

"Moshav" dichtav rachamana gabbe matztza umaror, lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena hoil uchetiv "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu", bizman deikka pesach – in, bizman delekka pesach – la, ka mashma lan.
"Bia" dichtav rachamana gabbe tefillin ufeter chamor, lema li? hahu mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael: ase mitzva zo, shebbishvilah tikkanes laaretz.
Bishlama leman deamar "moshav" – kol makom sheattem yoshvim mashma, hayeynu dichtiv "vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach" – mimmochorat happesach achul, meikkara – la achul. alma

a: Akruv omer vahadar achul.
Ella leman deamar leachar yerushsha vishiva, nechol lealtar! la havo tzerichi,

Dichtiv "uvene yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana ad boam el eretz noshavet, et hamman achlu ad boam el ketze eretz kenaan". i efshar lomar "ad boam el eretz noshavet", shekkevar neemar "el ketze eretz kenaan". vei efshar lomar "el ketze eretz kenaan", shehare kevar neemar: "ad boam el eretz noshavet". ha ketzad? beshiva baadar met moshe ufasak man millered, vehayu mistappekin mimman shebbichlehem ad shishsha asar benisan.

Tanya iddach: "uvene yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana". vechi arbaim shana achlu? vahalo arbaim shana chaser sheloshim yom achlu! ella lomar lecha: ugot shehotziu mimmitzrayim, taamu bahem taam man.

Tanya iddach: beshiva baadar met moshe, uveshiva baadar nolad. minnayin shebbeshiva baadar met – shenneemar: "vayyamot sham moshe eved Adonai", uchetiv: "vayyivku vene yisrael et moshe bearvot moav sheloshim yom", uchetiv: "vayhi achare mot moshe eved Adonai", uchetiv: "moshe avdi met veatta kum avor"

Uchetiv: "ivru bekerev hammachane vetzauu et haam lemor hachinu lachem tzeda ki beod sheloshet yamim taavru et hayyarden" uchetiv: "vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon", tze mehen sheloshim ushelosha yamim lemafrea, ha lamadta shebbeshiva baadar met moshe.

Uminnayin shebbeshiva baadar nolad moshe – shenneemar: "vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom lo uchal od latzet velavo", sheen talmud lomar "hayyom", ma talmud lomar "hayyom"? melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umemalle shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leyom umechodesh lechodesh, shenneemar: "et mispar yamecha amalle".
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz, venohagot ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz.
Vehu haddin sheyyinhagu, uma chadash, sheen issuro issur olam, veen issuro issur hanaa, veyesh hetter leissuro, noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz –
Kilayim, sheissuran issur olam, veissuran issur hanaa, veen hetter leissuran – eno din sheyyinhagu ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz? vehu haddin leorla bishtayim.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer:
b: Kol mitzva shennitztauu yisrael kodem kenisatan laaretz – noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. leachar kenisatan laaretz – enah noheget ella baaretz, chutz min hashematat kesafim veshilluach avadim, sheaf al pi shennitztauu alehem leachar kenisatan laaretz – noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz.
Hashematat kesafim chovat hagguf hi!

Lo nitzrecha ella lechidtanya. detanya, rabbi omer: "veze devar hashshemitta shamot" – bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber: achat shemittat karka, veachat shemittat kesafim. bizman sheatta meshammet karka – atta meshammet kesafim, bizman shei atta meshammet karka – i atta meshammet kesafim.
Veema: bimkom sheatta meshammet karka – atta meshammet kesafim, uvimkom sheen atta meshammet karka – en atta meshammet kesafim! talmud lomar: "ki kara shemitta laAdonai" mikkol makom.
Shilluach avadim chovat hagguf hi! salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ukeratem deror baaretz", baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la, talmud lomar: "yovel hi" – mikkol makom.
Im ken ma talmud lomar "baaretz"? bizman shehadderor noheg baaretz – noheg bechutza laaretz, en deror noheg baaretz – eno noheg bechutza laaretz.

Tenan hatam: hechadash asur min hattora bechol makom, orla halacha, vehakkilayim middivre sofrim. may halacha? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hilcheta medina. ulla amar rabbi yochanan: halacha lemoshe missinay.
Amar leh ulla lerav yehuda: bishlama ledidi, deamena halacha lemoshe missinay – hayeynu deshane lan ben sefek orla lisfek kilayim.
Ditnan: sefek orla, baaretz – asur, besureya – muttar. bechutza laaretz yored velokeach, uvilvad shello yirennu loket.
Veillu gabbe chilayim tenan: kerem hannatua yarak, veyarak nimkar chutza lo, baaretz – asur, besureya – muttar,
Bechutza laaretz – yored veloket. uvilvad shello yilkot bayyad.
Ella ledidach

a: Nitne o: "ze vaze yored velokeach", o: "ze vaze yored veloket"! haamar leh shemuel lerav anan: teni o: "ze vaze yored velokeach" o: "ze vaze yored veloket". mar bereh deravna matne leh lekulla: "ze vaze yored veloket, uvilvad shello yilkot bayyad".
Amar leh levi lishmuel: aryoch, sappek li, vaana echol. rav avya verabba bar rav chanan mesappeku sappoke lahadade. amri charife defumebdita: en orla bechutza laaretz.

Shalcha rav yehuda lekammeh derabbi yochanan. shelach leh: setom sefekah, veabbed vaddaa, vehacherez al perotehen shetteunim geniza. vechol haomer en orla bechutza laaretz – lo yehe lo nin vaneched, "mashlich chevel begoral bikhal Adonai".

Veinhu keman savruha? ki ha detanya: rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer mishshum rabbi yose ben dormaskit, sheamar mishshum rabbi yose haggelili, sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan ben nuri, sheamar mishshum rabbi eliezer haggadol: en orla bechutza laaretz.
Vela? vehaanan tenan rabbi eliezer omer: af hechadash! teni: "chadash".

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: orla bechutza laaretz halacha lemoshe missinay. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: vehatanya: sefek orla baaretz – asur, besureya – muttar, bechutza laaretz – yored veloket! "eshtomam keshaa chada" amar leh: ema kach neemra: sefekah muttar, vaddaah asur.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lokin al hakkilayim devar tora. amar leh rabbi elazar berabbi yose: vehaanan tenan: hakkilayim middivre sofrim! la kashya, kan bechile hakkerem, kan beharekavat hailan.
Kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: "et chukkotay tishmoru" – chukkim shechakakti lecha kevar, "behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra"
– Ma behemtecha beharebaa, af sadcha beharekava. uma behemtecha noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, af sadcha noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz.
Veella hachtiv: "sadcha"! hahu lemaote zeraim shebbechutza laaretz.
Rav chanan verav anan havo shakli veazli beorcha. chazyu lehahu gavra deka zara zeraim bahade hadade. amar leh: nete mar neshammeteh. amar leh: la chavvritu.

Vetu, chazyu lehahu gavra deka zara chitte useare be gufene. amar leh: nete mar neshammeteh. amar leh: la tzaharitu, la kayyma lan kerabbi yoshiyya deamar: ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad?!

Rav yosef mearev bizrane vezara. amar leh abbaye: vehaanan tenan: hakkilayim middivre sofrim! amar leh: la kashya, kan bechile hakkerem, kan bechile zeraim. kile hakkerem devaaretz asurim bahanaa – bechutza laaretz name gezaru behu rabbanan. kile zeraim devaaretz la asiri bahanaa – bechutza laaretz name la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Hadar amar rav yosef: lav milleta hi deamri, derav zara ginneta deve rav meshare meshare, may tama – lav mishshum eruv eruve chilayim? amar leh abbaye: bishlama i ashmeinan
b: Arba al arba ruchot haaruga veachat baemtza – shappir. ella hacha, mishshum noy. vei name mishshum tircha deshammaa hi.
Mishna kol haose mitzva achat – metivin lo, umaarichin lo yamav, venochel et haaretz. vechol sheeno ose mitzva achat – en metivin lo, veen maarichin lo yamav, veeno nochel et haaretz.

Gemara ureminhi: ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, ellu hen: kibbud av vaem, ugemilut chasadim, vehachenasat orchim, vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam.

Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar: kol haose mitzva achat yetera al zechiyyotav metivim lo, vedome kemi shemmekayyem kol hattora kullah. mikkelal dehanach afillu bachada name? amar rav shemaya: lomar sheim hayta shekula – machraat.

Vechol haose mitzva achat yetera al zechiyyotav metivin lo? ureminhu: kol shezzechiyyotav merubbin meavonotav – meriin lo, vedome kemi shessaraf kol hattora kullah velo shiyyer mimmenna afillu ot achat. vechol sheavonotav merubbin mizzechiyyotav – metivin lo, vedome kemi shekkiyyem kol hattora kullah velo chisser ot achat mimmenna!
Amar abbaye: matnitin deavdin leh yom tav vayom bish. rava amar: ha manni – rabbi yaakov hi, deamar: sechar mitzva behay alma lekka.

Detanya, rabbi yaakov omer: en lach kol mitzva umitzva shekketuva battora shemmattan secharah betziddah sheen techiyyayt hammetim teluya bah. bechibbud av vaem ketiv: "lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulemaan yitav lach", beshilluach hakken ketiv: "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim".

Hare sheamar lo aviv: ale labbira vehave li gozalot, veala labbira veshillach et haem venatal et habbanim uvachazirato nafal vamet – hechan tovat yamav shel ze, vehechan arichut yamav shel ze? ella: "lemaan yitav lach" – leolam shekkullo tov, "ulemaan yaarichun yamecha" – leolam shekkullo aroch.
Vedilma lav hachi hava? rabbi yaakov maase chaza. vedilma mehareher baavera hava? machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase.

Vedilma mehareher baavoda zara hava, uchetiv: "lemaan tefos et bet yisrael belibbam"?! ihu name hachi kaamar: i salka datach sechar mitzva behay alma, ammay la aggin mitzvot aleh ki hechi dela lete lide hirhur?
Veha amar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva en nizzokin! hatam bahalichatan shane.

Veha amar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin lo bahalichatan velo bachaziratan! sullam raua hava, dikvia hezzeka, vechol hecha dikvia hezzeka la samchinan annissa. dichtiv: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani".
Amar rav yosef: ilmale darsheh acher lehay kera kerabbi yaakov bar beratte – la chata. veacher may hu? ikka deamri: ki hay gavvna chaza.
Veikka deamri: lishshana dechutzepit hameturegman chaza dahava garayr leh davar acher. amar: pe shehefik margaliyyot yelachech afar?! nefak chata.

Rame rav tovi bar rav kisna lerava: tenan kol haose mitzva achat metivin lo: asa – in, lo asa – la. ureminhi: yashav velo avar avera – notnim lo sachar keose mitzva! amar leh: hatam, kegon shebba devar avera leyado venitztzol hemenna.

Ki ha derabbi chanina bar pappe tevateh hahi matronita. amar milleta umalli nafsheh shichna vechiva, avada hi milleta veittassi. arak, tesha behahu be vane dechi havo ayylin bitren afillu bimama havo mittazzeki. limchar amaru leh rabbanan: man natrach? amar lehu: shene
