a: Nose kesar shemaruni kol hallayla. amaru leh: shemma devar erva ba leyadcha venitztzalta hemennu, ditnena: kol habba devar erva leyado venitztzal hemennu – osin lo nes. "gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro" – kegon rabbi tzadok vachaverav.

Rabbi tzadok tevateh hahi matronita, amar la: chalash li libbay vela matzena, ikka midde lemechal? amara leh: ikka davar tame. amar la: may nafka minna? deaved ha – achevl ha. shegarat tannura, ka mannecha leh. salek veyatev begavveh. amara leh: may hay? amar la: deaved ha – nafel beha. amra leh: i yadi kulle hay – la tzaartaych.

Rav kahana hava kamzabben dikkule, tevateh hahi matronita. amar la: ezil eykashshet nafshay, salek vekanafel meiggara leara. ata eliyyahu kabbeleh. amar leh: atrachtan arba mea parse! amar leh: mi geram li, lav anyuta? yehav leh shifa dedinare.

Rame leh rava lerav nachman: tenan: ellu devarim sheadam ose otan veochel perotehen beolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, ellu hen: kibbud av veem, ugemilut chasadim, vahavaat shalom shebben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam.
Bechibbud av vaem ketiv: "lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulemaan yitav lach", bigmilut chasadim ketiv: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod",

Uvahavaat shalom ketiv: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu", veamar rabbi avahu: atya "redifa" "redifa". ketiv hacha: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu", uchetiv hatam: "rodef tzedaka vachesed". betalmud tora ketiv: "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha".
Beshilluach hakken name ketiv: "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim", litne name ha! tena veshayyayr. tane tanna: "ellu devarim", veat amrat tena veshayyayr?!

Amar rava: rav idi asbera li: "imru tzaddik ki tov ki feri maallehem yochelu" – vechi yesh tzaddik tov veyesh tzaddik sheeno tov? ella: tov lashshamayim velabberiyyot – zehu tzaddik tov, tov lashshamayim vera labberiyyot – zehu tzaddik sheeno tov.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "oy lerasha ra ki gemul yadav yease lo". vechi yesh rasha ra veyesh sheeno ra? ella: ra lashshamayim vera labberiyyot – hu rasha ra, ra lashshamayim veeno ra labberiyyot – zehu rasha sheeno ra.
Hazzechut yesh lah keren veyesh lah perot, shenneemar: "imru tzaddik ki tov vegomer" – avera yesh lah keren veen lah perot, shenneemar: "oy larasha ra vegomer"
Veella ma ani mekayyem: "veyochlu mipperi darkam umimmoatzotehem yisbau"? avera sheosa perot – yesh lah perot. vesheen osa perot – en lah perot.

Machshava tova metzarfah lemaase, shenneemar: "az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo". may: "vlchoshve shemo"? amar rav assi: afillu chashav adam laasot mitzva veneenas velo asaah – maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah.

Machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase, shenneemar: "aven im raiti velibbi lo yishma Adonai". veella ma ani mekayyem: "hinni mevi el haam hazze raa peri machshevotam"? machshava sheosa peri hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase, machshava sheen bah peri – en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase.
Veella ha dichtiv: "lemaan tefos et [bet] yisrael belibbam"? amar rav acha bar yaakov: hahu baavoda zara hu dichtiv, deamar mar: chamura avoda zara, shekkol hakkofer bah kemode bechol hattora kullah.
Ulla amar: kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah – huttera lo. huttera lo salka datach?! ella: naaset lo kehetter.

Amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina: noach lo laadam sheyyaavor avera basseter veal yechallel shem shamayim befarhesya, shenneemar: "veattem bet yisrael ko amar Adonai ish gillulav lechu avodu [veachar] im enchem shomim elay, veet shem kodshi lo techallelu".

Amar rabbi ilay hazzaken: im roe adam sheyyitzro mitgabber alav – yelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto, veyilbash shechorim, veyitkasse shechorim, veyaase kemo shellibbo chafetz, veal yechallel shem shamayim befarhesya.
Ini? vehatanya: kol shello chas al kevod kono – rauy lo shello ba laolam. ma hi? rabba omer: ze hammistakkel bakkeshet. rav yosef omer: ze haover avera basseter!
La kashya, ha – dematze kayef leyitzreh, veha – dela matze kayef leyitzreh.
Tenan hatam: en makkifin bechillul hashshem, echad shogeg veechad mezid. may "en makkifin"? amar mar zutera: sheen osim kechenvoni. mar bereh deravna amar: lomar sheim hayta shekula – machraat.
Tanu rabbanan: leolam
b: Yire adam atzmo keillu chetzyo chayyayv vechetzyo zakkay. asa mitzva achat – ashrav, shehichria atzmo lechaf zechut, avar avera achat – oy lo, shehichria et atzmo lechaf chova, shenneemar: "vechote echad yeabbed tova harebe" – bishvil chet yechidi shechata oved mimmennu tovot harebe.

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lefi shehaolam niddon achar rubbo, vehayyachid niddon achar rubbo, asa mitzva achat – ashrav, shehichria et atzmo veet kol haolam lechaf zechut, avar avera achat – oy lo, shehichria et atzmo veet kol haolam lechaf chova, shenneemar: "vechote echad kulei" – bishvil chet yechidi sheasa ze avad mimmennu umikkol haolam tova harebe.

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: afillu tzaddik gamur kol yamav umarad baacharona – ibbed et harishonot, shenneemar: "tzidkat hatztzaddik lo tatztzilennu beyom pisho". vaafillu rasha gamur kol yamav veasa teshuva baacharona – en mazkirim lo shuv risho, shenneemar: "verishat harasha lo yikkashel bah beyom shuvo merisho".
Venihve kemechetza avonot umechetza zechiyyot? amar resh lakish: betohe al harishonot.

Mishna kol sheyyeshno bammikra uvammishna uvederech eretz – lo bimhera hu chote, shenneemar: "vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek". vechol sheeno lo bammikra velo bammishna velo bederech eretz – eno min hayyishshuv.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: lema tzaddikim nimshalim baolam hazze – leilan shekkullo omed bimkom tohora, venofo note limkom tumea. niktzatz nofo – kullo omed bimkom tohora. kach hakkadosh baruch hu mevi yissurim al tzaddikim baolam hazze, kede sheyyirshu haolam habba, shenneemar: "vehaya reshitcha mitzar veacharitcha yisge meod".

Ulema reshaim domim baolam hazze – leilan shekkullo omed bimkom tumea venofo note limkom tohora. niktzatz nofo – kullo omed bimkom tumea. kach hakkadosh baruch hu meshappea lahen tova larshaim beolam hazze kede letordan ulehorishan lemadrega hattachtona, shenneemar: "yesh derech yashar lifne ish veacharitah darche mavet".

Uchevar haya rabbi tarfon uzekenim mesubbin baaliyyat bet natteza belod. nishala sheela zo bifnehem: talmud gadol o maase gadol? naana rabbi tarfon veamar: maase gadol. naana rabbi akiva veamar: talmud gadol. naanu kullam veamru: talmud gadol, shehattalmud mevi lide maase.
Tanya, rabbi yose omer: gadol talmud shekkadam lechalla arbaim shana, litrumot ulemaasrot chamishshim vearba, lishmittim shishshim veachat, leyovlot mea veshalosh.
Mea veshalosh? mea vearba havyayn! kasavar: yovel mittechillato hu meshammet.
Ucheshem shehallimmud kodem lemaase kach dino kodem lemaase, kidrav hamenuna. deamar rav hamenuna: en techillat dino shel adam ella al divre tora, shenneemar: "poter mayim reshit madon".
Ucheshem sheddino kodem lemaase kach secharo kodem lemaase, shenneemar: "vayyitten lahem artzot goyim vaamal leummim yirashu. baavur yishmeru chukkav vetorotav yintzoru".

Kol sheeno lo bammikra velo bammishna. amar rabbi yochanan: ufasul leedut. tanu rabbanan: haochel bashshuk hare ze dome lechelev. veyesh omrim pasul leedut. amar rabbi idi bar avin: halacha keyesh omrim.
Darash bar kappara: ragzan

a: Lo alta beyado ella ragzanuta. uleadam tov matimim oto mipperi maasav. vechol sheeno lo bammikra velo bammishna velo bederech eretz – dor hanaa mimmennu, shenneemar: "uvemoshav letzim lo yashav" – moshavo moshav letzim.
Hadaran alach haishsha niknet
Haish mekaddesh bo uvishlucho. haishsha mitkaddeshet bah uvishluchah. haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara, bo uvishlucho.
Gemara hasheta bishlucho mekaddesh, bo mibbaya?! amar rav yosef: mitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho. ki ha derav safra mecharech resha, rava malach shibbuta.

Ikka deamri: beha issura name it be, kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asur laadam sheyyekaddesh et haishsha ad sheyyirenna, shemma yire bah davar megunne vetitganne alav, verachamana amar: "veahavta lereacha kamocha".

Vechi ittemar derav yosef – assefa ittemar, haishsha mitkaddeshet bah uvishluchah. hasheta bishluchah mikkaddesha bah mibbaya?! amar rav yosef: mitzva bah yoter mibbishluchah. ki ha derav safra mecharech resha, rava malach shibbuta.
Aval beha issura let ba, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu.

Haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara. keshehi naara – in, keshehi ketanna – la. mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav veittema rabbi elazar: asur leadam sheyyekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna, ad shettigdal vetomar: "bifloni ani rotza".
Shelichut menalan? detanya: "veshillach" – melammed shehu ose shaliach.
"Veshillechah" – melammed shehi osa "shaliach". "veshillach" "veshillechah" – melammed shehashshaliach ose shaliach.

Ashkechan begerushin, bekiddushin menalan? vechi tema deyalef miggerushin – ma legerushin, shekken yeshnan beal korchah! amar kera: "veyatza" "vehayta" – makkish havaya litzia, ma yetzia meshavve shaliach – af havaya name meshavve shaliach.
Veella ha ditnan: haomer lishlucho: "tze terom" – torem kedaat baal habbayit. veim eno yodea daat baal habbayit – torem bevenonit, echad mechamishshim.
b: Pichet asara o hosif asara – terumato teruma. menalan? vechi tema deyalef miggerushin – ma legerushin, shekken yeshnan chol! amar kera: "attem", "gam attem" – lerabbot et hashshaliach.
Venichtov rachamana bitruma, veneto hanach venigmeru minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: shekken yeshnah bemachshava.

Veha ditnan: chavura sheavad pischah, veamru leechad: "tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu", vehalach umatza veshachat, vehen lakchu veshachatu, im shello nishchat rishon – hu ochel mishshello, vehem ochlim veshotim immo.
Menalan? vechi tema deyalef mehanach – ma lehanach, shekken yeshnan chol etzel kadashim!

Nafka leh midderabbi yehoshua ben korcha, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: minnayin sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto? shenneemar: "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim", vechi kol hakkahal kullan shochatin? vahalo eno shochet ella echad! ella mikkan sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto.
Nichtov rachamana bekadashim, venete hanach venigmeru minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lekadashim, shekken rov maasehen al yede shaliach.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte? – he tete?
La nichtov rachamana bekadashim vetete mehanach – ma lehanach, shekken yeshnan chol etzel kodashim. la nichtov rachamana begerushin vetete mehanach – ma lehanach, shekken yeshnan bemachshava.
Ella: la lichtov rachamana bitruma, vetete mehanach! hachi name.
Veella "attem" "gam attem" lema li? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yannay. deamar rabbi yannay "gam attem" – ma attem bene berit, af sheluchachem bene berit.

Ha lema li kera? midderabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan nafka! deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get miyyad balah shel ishsha, lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin.

Itzterich, salka datach amena: eved, delav bar hettera hu kelal. aval nochri, hoil veiteh bitruma denafsheh, ditnan: hannochri vehakkuti shettarmu – terumatan teruma, ema shaliach name aved, kamashma lan.
Ulerabbi shimon, defatar, ditnan: terumat nochri medammaat vechayyayvin aleha chomesh verabbi shimon poter, "attem" "gam attem" lema li?

Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veamar mar: "attem" – velo arisin, "attem" – velo shuttafin, "attem" – velo appotroppos, "attem" – velo hattorem et sheeno shello, ema: "attem" – velo sheluchachem name, ka mashma lan.
Hanicha lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha. ella lerabbi yonatan, demappek leh lehay kera lidrasha acharina, mena lan? detanya, rabbi yonatan omer: minnayin shekkol yisrael kullan yotzim

a: Befesach echad? shenneemar: "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim", vechi kol hakkahal kullam shochatim? vahalo eno shochet ella echad! ella mikkan shekkol yisrael yotzim befesach echad – shaliach bekadashim mena leh?
– Minneh. vedilma shane hatam, deit leh shuttafut begavvayyhu.

Ella mehacha: "veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se labbayit". vedilma hatam name, deit leh shuttafut begavvayyhu? im ken tere kerae lema li? im eno inyan lehecha deshayech tenehu inyan lehecha dela shayech.
Hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: "ish" zoche, velo hakkatan zoche. hahu meish lefi ochlo" nafka.
Veakkatti mibbee leh deshochatin et happesach al hayyachid. savar la keman deamar: en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid.

Veella ha deamar rav giddel amar rav: minnayin sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto? shenneemar: "venasi echad nasi echad mimmatte". tippok leh shelichut mehacha! vetisbera deha shelichut hu? veha ketannim lav bene shelichut ninhu!

Ella, ki ha derava bar rav huna. deamar rava bar rav huna amar rav giddel amar rav: minnayin shezzachin leadam shello befanav? shenneemar: "venasi echad nasi echad". vetisbera zechut hi? ha chova name ikka, deikka denicha leh behar, vela nicha leh bevika, veikka denicha leh bevika vela nicha leh behar!

Veella kidrava bar rav huna. deamar rava bar rav huna amar rav giddel amar rav: minnayin litomim shebbau lachalok benichse avihen shebbet din maamidin lahem appotroppos lachuv velizkot? "lachuv" ammay? ella: "lachuv al menat lizkot" – talmud lomar: "venasi echad nasi echad mimmatte tikchu".

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: yetomim shebbau lachlok benichse avihem – bet din maamidim lahem appotroppos, uvorrim lahem chelek yafe, veim higdilu – yecholim lemachot. verav nachman dideh amar: im higdilu enam yecholim lemachot, deim ken ma koach bet din yafe?

Umi it leh lerav nachman "im ken ma koach bet din yafe"? vehatnan: shum haddayyaynim sheppichatu shetut o hotiru shetut – michran batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: michran kayyaym. (veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel): im ken – ma koach bet din yafe! veamar rav huna bar chinnana amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim.
La kashya:
b: Ha – dito, ha – dela teo. i dela teo, may yecholim lemachot? yecholim lemachot beruchot.
Amar rav nachman: haachin shechalku hare hen kelakochot. pachot mishshetut – nikne mikkach. yater al shetut – batel mikkach. shetut – kana, umachzir onaa.
Amar rava: ha daamaran "pachot mishshetut – nikne mikkach" – la amaran ella dela shavveye shaliach, aval shavveye shaliach, amar: letakkone shaddartaycha vela leauote.

Veha daamaran "yater mishshetut – batel mikkach" – la amaran ella dela amar (nifligan) [niflog] beshuma deve dina, aval amar niflog beshuma deve dina – michran kayyaym, ditnan: shum haddayyaynim sheppichatu shetut o hotiru shetut – michran batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: michran kayyaym.

Veha daamaran "shetut – kana, umachzir onaa" – la amaran ella bemittaltele, aval bimkarkee – en onaa lekarkaot. uvimkarkee la amaran, ella diflug beilluya, aval pelug bemishchata – la, kidrabba. deamar rabba: kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, afillu pachot mikkede onaa – name chozer.
Veha ditnan: hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. shillach beyad pikkeach – pikkeach chayyayv.
Veammay? nema: shelucho shel adam kemoto! shane hatam deen shaliach lidvar avera. deamrinan: divre harav vedivre talmid – divre mi shomim?
Vehadtanya: shaliach shello asa shelichuto – shaliach maal, asa shelichuto – baal habbayit maal. ki asa shelichuto devaal habbayit – baal habbayit miha maal. ammay? nema: en shaliach lidvar avera!
Shane meila, deyalfa "chet" "chet" mitteruma: ma teruma meshavve shaliach – af meila meshavve shaliach.
Venelaf minna! mishshum dehave meila ushelichut yad shene ketuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin. meila – ha daamaran. shelichut yad may hi?
Detanya: "al kol devar pesha", bet shammay omrim: lechayyev al hammachshava kemaase. uvet hillel omrim: eno chayyayv ad sheyyishlach bo yad, shenneemar: "im lo shalach yado vegomer".

Amru bet shammay levet hillel: vahalo neemar "al kol devar pesha"! amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: vahalo neemar "im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu"! amru bet shammay levet hillel: im ken, "al kol devar pesha" lema li? sheyyachol en li ella hu, amar leavdo velishlucho minnayin – talmud lomar: "al kol devar pesha".
Hanicha levet hillel. ella levet shammay, demokmi leh lehay kera bemachshava kemaase,

a: Nelaf minneh! mishshum dehave meila tevicha umechira shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin. meila – ha daamaran, tevicha umechira may hi? amar kera: "utevacho o mecharo" – ma mechira al yede acher, af tevicha al yede acher.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "o" – lerabbot et hashshaliach. deve chizkiyya tana: "tachat" – lerabbot et hashshaliach.

Hanicha leman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin. ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar? galli rachamana bishchute chutz, "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach" – hu velo shelucho.
Ashkechan gabbe shechute chutz, bechol hattora menalan? deyalef mishshechute chutz.
Addeyalef mishshechute chutz, nelayf mehanach! hadar ketav rachamana: "venichrat haish hahu" – im eno inyan legufo, tenehu inyan lechol hattora kullah.

Uleman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedim, hane "hahu" "hahu" may daresh behu? chad, lemaote shenayim sheochazim besakkin veshochatim, vechad, "hu" – velo anus, "hu" – velo shogeg, "hu" – velo mutee.
Veiddach? mehu" "hahu". veiddach? "hu" "hahu" la daresh.

Veha detane: haomer lishlucho: "tze harog et hannefesh", hu – chayyayv, vesholchav – patur. shammay hazzaken omer mishshum chaggay hannavi: sholchav chayyayv, shenneemar: "oto haragta becherev bene ammon".
May tameh deshammay hazzaken? kasavar: shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin, vehu" "hahu" la daresh. veibbaet ema: leolam daresh, umay chayyayv – chayyayv bedine shamayim.
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar: afillu middine shamayim name patur?! ella: dina rabba vedina zuta ikka benayyhu.
Veibbaet ema: shane hatam degalli rachamana: "oto haragta becherev bene ammon".

Veiddach: hare lecha kecherev bene ammon, ma cherev bene ammon – en atta neenash alav, af uriyya hachitti – i atta neenash alav. may tama – mored bammalchut hava, dekaamar leh: "vadoni yoav veavde adoni al pene hassade chonim".

Amar rava: im timtze lomar savar shammay shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin, vehu" "hahu" la daresh, mode beomer lishlucho "tze beol et haerva" veechol et hachelev" shehu chayyayv, vesholchav patur. shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah ze nehene veze mitchayyev.

Ittemar, rav amar: shaliach naase ed. deve rabbi shela amri: en shaliach naase ed. may tama deve rabbi shela? illema mishshum dela amar leh: "heve li ed" – ella meatta kiddesh ishsha bifne shenayim vela amar lahem: "attem edayy" – hachi name dela havu kiddushe?
Ella, rav amar: shaliach naase ed – allome ka meallemna lemilleteh. deve rabbi shela amri: en shaliach naase ed – kevan deamar mar: "shelucho shel adam kemoto" – have leh kegufeh.

Metivi: amar lishlosha "tzeu vekaddeshu li haishsha" – echad shaliach ushenayim edim, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: kullam sheluchin hen, veen shaliach naase ed. ad kan la peligi ella bishlosha, aval bishnayim – divre hakkol la!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi natan omer, bet shammay omrim: shaliach veed echad. uvet hillel omrim: shaliach ushene edim. verav kevet shammay?! efoch. verav acha bereh derava matni ippecha: rav amar: en shaliach naase ed, deve rabbi shela amri: shaliach naase ed. vehilcheta: shaliach naase ed.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: amar lishnayim: "tzeu vekaddeshu li et haishsha" – hen hen sheluchav, hen hen edav. vechen begerushin,
b: Vechen bedine mamonot.
Utzericha dei ashmeinan bekiddushin – mishshum dilmesra kaate, aval gerushin – nechush shemma enav natan bah.
Vei ashmeinan gerushin – mishshum deitteta leve tere la chazya, aval mamona – ema: hane miflag palgi. tzerichi.
May kasavar? i kasavar hammalve chavero beedim tzarich leforo beedim – hane nogim beedut ninhu, dei amri: "la peraneh" amar lehu: "perauni"!
Ella leolam kasavar: hammalve et chavero beedim en tzarich leforo beedim, umiggo deyachli lememar: "ahderinhu lelove", yecholin lememar: "peraneh lemalve".
Vehasheta detakkun rabbanan shevuat hesset – mishtavi hane edim deyahevna leh, umishteva malve dela shakel leh, ufara leh love lemalve.

Haish mekaddesh et bitto. tenan hatam: naara hameorasa – hi veaviha mekabbelin et gittah. amar rabbi yehuda: en shete yadayim zochot keechad, ella aviha mekabbel et gittah. vechol sheen yechola lishmor et gittah – en yechola lehitgaresh.
Amar resh lakish: kemachloket legerushin, kach machloket lekiddushin. verabbi yochanan amar: machloket legerushin, aval lekiddushin – divre hakkol aviha velo hi.

Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tameh derabbi yochanan allibba derabbanan? gerushin, demachneset atzmah lirshut aviha – ben hi uven aviha. kiddushin, demafkaat atzmah mershut aviha – aviha velo hi.
